Title: 1. Swiss Family Robinson
description: A Swiss family must survive being shipwrecked on a deserted island.

Title: 2. Psycho
description: A secretary on the run for embezzlement takes refuge at a secluded California motel owned by a repressed man and his overbearing mother.

Title: 3. The Apartment
description: A Manhattan insurance clerk tries to rise in his company by letting its executives use his apartment for trysts, but office politics and his own romantic hopes complicate matters.

Title: 4. Spartacus
description: The slave Spartacus survives brutal training as a gladiator and leads a violent revolt against the decadent Roman Republic, as the ambitious Crassus seeks to gain power by crushing the uprising.

Title: 5. Breathless
description: A small-time crook, hunted by the authorities for a car theft and the murder of a police officer, attempts to persuade a hip American journalism student to run away with him to Italy.

Title: 6. Mughal-E-Azam
description: A 16th century prince falls in love with a court dancer and battles with his emperor father.

Title: 7. The Big Risk
description: A ruthless criminal flees from the pursuit, involving more and more casualties.

Title: 8. Eyes Without a Face
description: A surgeon causes a car accident which leaves his daughter disfigured and goes to extreme lengths to give her a new face.

Title: 9. The Bad Sleep Well
description: A vengeful young man marries the daughter of a corrupt industrialist in order to seek justice for his father's suicide.

Title: 10. Peeping Tom
description: A young man murders women, using a movie camera to film their dying expressions of terror.

Title: 11. Le Trou
description: Distrust and uncertainty arise when four long-term inmates cautiously induct a new prisoner into their elaborate prison-break scheme.

Title: 12. The Passionate Thief
description: Tortorella tries to spend New Year's Eve with her wealthy friends, but ends up with an actor in decay and a pickpocket.

Title: 13. Shoot the Piano Player
description: A pianist helps his brother escape from two gangsters, who retaliate by abducting their kid brother.

Title: 14. The Pusher
description: A detective investigating the murder of a heroin addict discovers that there is a connection between the junkie and his fiancee, who is his boss' daughter.

Title: 15. The Magnificent Seven
description: Seven gunfighters are hired by Mexican peasants to liberate their village from oppressive bandits.

Title: 16. La Dolce Vita
description: A series of stories following a week in the life of a philandering tabloid journalist living in Rome.

Title: 17. Ocean's Eleven
description: Danny Ocean gathers a group of his World War II compatriots to pull off the ultimate Las Vegas heist. Together the eleven friends plan to rob five Las Vegas casinos in one night.

Title: 18. Black Sunday
description: Decades after being executed for witchcraft, vengeful Princess Asa Vajda and her fiendish servant are resurrected and begin a bloody campaign to possess the body of Asa Vajda's beautiful look-alike descendant Princess Katia.

Title: 19. Purple Noon
description: Tom Ripley is a talented mimic, moocher, forger and all-around criminal improviser; but there's more to Tom Ripley than even he can guess.

Title: 20. Inherit the Wind
description: Based on a real-life case in 1925; two great lawyers argue the case for, and against, a Tennessee science teacher accused of the crime of teaching Darwin's theory of evolution.

Title: 21. The Time Machine
description: A turn-of-the-century inventor's vision for a utopian society is disillusioned when travelling forward in time reveals a dark and dangerous fate for humanity.

Title: 22. Rocco and His Brothers
description: Having recently been uprooted to Milan, Rocco and his four brothers each look for a new way in life when a prostitute comes between Rocco and his brother Simone.

Title: 23. The Virgin Spring
description: In 14th century Sweden, an innocent yet pampered teenage girl and a jealous pregnant servant set out from their farm to deliver candles to church - but only one returns because of events that transpire along the way.

Title: 24. Village of the Damned
description: In the English village of Midwich, the blonde-haired, glowing-eyed children of uncertain paternity prove to have frightening powers.

Title: 25. L'Avventura
description: A woman disappears during a Mediterranean boating trip. During the search, her lover and her best friend become attracted to each other.

Title: 26. House of Usher
description: Upon entering his fiancée's family mansion, a man discovers a savage family curse and fears that his future brother-in-law has entombed his bride-to-be prematurely.

Title: 27. Horror Hotel
description: A young college student arrives in a sleepy Massachusetts town to research witchcraft; during her stay at an eerie inn, she discovers a startling secret about the town and its inhabitants.

Title: 28. Elmer Gantry
description: A charming con man joins an itinerant evangelical sister who travels the American Midwest taking advantage of gullible locals in the 1920s.

Title: 29. Exodus
description: The State of Israel is created in 1948, resulting in war with its Arab neighbors.

Title: 30. The Goddess
description: A young woman is deemed a goddess when her father-in-law, a rich feudal land-lord, has a dream envisioning her as an avatar of Kali.

Title: 31. Testament of Orpheus
description: The Poet looks back over his life and work, recalling his inspirations and obsessions.

Title: 32. Pollyanna
description: A young girl comes to an embittered town and confronts its attitude with her determination to see the best in life.

Title: 33. The Little Shop of Horrors
description: A clumsy young man working at an impoverished flower shop discovers that the strange plant he has been nurturing has an insatiable appetite for blood, forcing him to kill to feed it.

Title: 34. 13 Ghosts
description: A family inherits a house with 12 ghosts who want a 13th.

Title: 35. The Sinners of Hell
description: A group of sinners involved in interconnected tales of murder, revenge, deceit and adultery all meet at the Gates of Hell.

Title: 36. White Nights
description: A Dreamer, living in a big city for a few years and all the time he is alone. But one summer in St. Petersburg's White Nights on the Neva, he meets Nastya.

Title: 37. The Housemaid
description: A composer and his wife are thrown into turmoil when a housemaid becomes more than they bargained for.

Title: 38. Tunes of Glory
description: After World War II, a Highland Regiment's acting Commanding Officer, who rose from the ranks, is replaced by a peacetime Oxford-educated Commanding Officer, leading to a dramatic conflict between the two.

Title: 39. Sink the Bismarck!
description: The World War II story of the Royal Navy's effort to defeat Nazi Germany's most powerful warship.

Title: 40. The Fugitive Kind
description: A guitar-playing drifter wanders into a small Mississippi town and inflames two troubled women.

Title: 41. Wild River
description: A TVA bureaucrat comes to the river to do what none of his predecessors have been able to do - evict a stubborn octogenarian from her island before the rising waters engulf her.

Title: 42. The Young One
description: A jazz musician seeks refuge from a lynch mob on a remote island, where he meets a hostile game warden and the young object of his attentions.

Title: 43. The Naked Island
description: A family of four are the sole inhabitants of a small island where they struggle each day to irrigate their crops.

Title: 44. Letter Never Sent
description: Four geologists search for diamonds in the wilderness of Siberia.

Title: 45. The Unforgiven
description: The neighbors of a frontier family turn on them when it is suspected that their adopted daughter was stolen from the local Kiowa tribe.

Title: 46. Circus of Horrors
description: Dr. Rossiter, a plastic surgeon wanted by the police, flees to France and under an assumed name acquires, by murder, a run-down circus. His first recruit is a woman criminal. He transforms her face by surgery and trains her.

Title: 47. Skeleton of Mrs. Morales
description: A taxidermist decides to murder his wife after having to put up with her after fifteen years of hellish marriage.

Title: 48. Can-Can
description: In 1896 Paris, a female nightclub proprietor fights against the forces of public morality for the right to feature her performers doing the risqué dance, the can-can.

Title: 49. I Aim at the Stars
description: The story of rocket scientist Dr. Werner von Braun's career, from the 1920s until the late 1950s.

Title: 50. Let's Make Love
description: After billionaire Jean-Marc Clément learns that he is to be satirized in an off-Broadway revue, he passes himself off as the actor playing him in order to get closer to the beautiful star of the show, Amanda Dell.

Title: 51. Macario
description: Poor and hungry peasant Macario wishes to have a good meal for All Saint's Day. After his wife cooks him a turkey he has three apparitions: The Devil, God, and the Death.

Title: 52. Saturday Night and Sunday Morning
description: A rebellious, hard-living factory worker juggles relationships with two women, one of whom is married to another man but pregnant with his child.

Title: 53. Midnight Lace
description: In London, a recently-wed American woman's sanity comes into question after she claims to be the victim of a threatening stalker.

Title: 54. The Flesh and the Fiends
description: In 1828 Scotland, Edinburgh surgeon Dr. Knox does medical research on cadavers he buys from murderers Burke and Hare, without questioning the unethical procurement methods.

Title: 55. Murder, Inc.
description: The rise and fall of a 1930's Brooklyn crime syndicate, known as Murder Incorporated, led by mobster Lepke Buchalter.

Title: 56. The Devil's Eye
description: Don Juan is sent from Hell to Earth with a mission - to seduce a virgin in order to spoil her pure wedding. The mission becomes crazy when Don Juan falls in love for the first time in centuries.

Title: 57. Hell to Eternity
description: After his adoptive Japanese-American family is sent to Manzanar after Pearl Harbor, a young Chicano enlists in the Marines and becomes a hero in the Battle of Saipan.

Title: 58. The Battle of Austerlitz
description: Another of Napoleon's adventures in this epic reconstruction of the battle of Austerlitz, where he had the greatest victory of his career, over the Russians.

Title: 59. The Cloud-Capped Star
description: A selfless young woman (Supriya Choudhury) sacrifices her own happiness for her unappreciative family.

Title: 60. The Rise and Fall of Legs Diamond
description: Neo-noir about a small-time New York City criminal whose ambition is to become a big-time crime boss during the Prohibition era.

Title: 61. The Hypnotic Eye
description: A mysterious hypnotist is suspected by the police of being responsible for a wave of female mutilation victims.

Title: 62. The Hands of Orlac
description: A pianist who loses his hands in a plane crash receives the transplanted hands of an executed criminal, and his new hands have the murderous tendencies of their previous owner.

Title: 63. Bad Luck
description: To convince the prison warden against releasing him, a middle-aged Polish man recounts his life, one he considers to have been characterized by exceptionally bad luck.

Title: 64. Intimidation
description: A bank manager is blackmailed into robbing his own bank.

Title: 65. The Alamo
description: In 1836, a small band of soldiers sacrifice their lives in hopeless combat against a massive army in order to prevent a tyrant from smashing the new Republic of Texas.

Title: 66. Sword of Sherwood Forest
description: While King Richard is away at the Crusades, some Nottingham nobles and their Sheriff plot to confiscate estates of fallen Crusaders but Robin Hood and Maid Marian foil their plan.

Title: 67. Comanche Station
description: A man saves a woman who had been kidnapped by Comanches, then struggles to get both of them home alive.

Title: 68. Two Women
description: In WWII Italy, a widow and her lonely daughter seek distance between themselves and the horrors of war.

Title: 69. The Brides of Dracula
description: Vampire hunter Dr. Van Helsing returns to Transylvania to destroy handsome bloodsucker Baron Meinster, who has designs on a beautiful young schoolteacher.

Title: 70. The Angel Wore Red
description: Father Arturo Carrera leaves the priesthood over the church's indifferent position during the Spanish Civil War, but finds himself attracted to beautiful entertainer Soledad.

Title: 71. North to Alaska
description: During the Alaska gold rush, prospector George sends partner Sam to Seattle to bring back his fiancée but after it turns out that she married another man, Sam returns with a pretty substitute, the hostess of the Henhouse dance hall.

Title: 72. Home from the Hill
description: Dramatic story of the influential Hunnicutt family set in Texas during the late 1950s.

Title: 73. BUtterfield 8
description: A beautiful New York model and socialite enjoys a very active night-life, but all things change when she falls for a married man and the consequences are tragic.

Title: 74. Bells Are Ringing
description: A Brooklyn answering-service operator becomes involved in the lives of her clients, including a struggling playwright with whom she falls in love.

Title: 75. Devil's Partner
description: An old man sells his soul to the devil, and turns into a young man. He then uses witchcraft and black magic to win a woman from his rival.

Title: 76. The Wackiest Ship in the Army
description: During WW2, Lt. Rip Crandall, who was a yachtsman before the war, takes command of the USS Echo, a sailing ship, for a secret mission in waters patrolled by Japanese warships.

Title: 77. Where the Boys Are
description: Four Midwestern college girls travel to Fort Lauderdale, Florida for their spring break. Adventure, romance, and heartbreak await them.

Title: 78. The League of Gentlemen
description: A disgruntled veteran recruits a group of disgraced colleagues to perform a bank robbery with military precision.

Title: 79. Please Don't Eat the Daisies
description: Drama professor turned theater critic balances his home life and career after he moves to the country with his wife and their four sons.

Title: 80. Let No Man Write My Epitaph
description: In this sequel to "Knock On Any Door", the residents of a Chicago tenement building band together to insure that the son of Nick Romano does not follow in his father's footsteps...to the electric chair.

Title: 81. The Lost World
description: Professor Challenger leads an expedition of scientists and adventurers to a remote plateau deep in the Amazonian jungle to verify his claim that dinosaurs still live there.

Title: 82. Never Take Candy from a Stranger
description: In Canada, a British schoolmaster meets official resistance when he learns that his 9-year-old daughter has been the victim of the pedophile patriarch of the town's most powerful family.

Title: 83. Cimarron
description: The Oklahoma Land Run of April 1889 sets the stage for an epic saga of a frontier adventurer, his wife and family and their friends.

Title: 84. School for Scoundrels
description: A young man finds a very special school. It teaches him how to take advantage of people. He begins to put the lessons into operation.

Title: 85. Sergeant Rutledge
description: A respected black cavalry sergeant stands court-martial after being accused of raping and killing a white woman as well as murdering her father, his superior officer.

Title: 86. Private Property
description: An arrogant criminal offers to seduce a woman for his dim, sexually inexperienced partner.

Title: 87. The Truth
description: A liberated small-town girl stands on trial to determine whether she killed her lover in a crime of passion or in premeditation.

Title: 88. The Entertainer
description: Archie Rice, an old-time British music hall performer sinking into final defeat, schemes to stay in show business.

Title: 89. Never on Sunday
description: An American intellectual tries to reform a happy Greek prostitute.

Title: 90. The Grass Is Greener
description: Victor and Hilary have guided tours in their English mansion. A US oil tycoon "bumps" into Hilary during a tour and charms his way into her heart. Meanwhile, Hattie pursues Victor.

Title: 91. Tormented
description: A man lets a former flame fall to her death rather than let her interfere with his new relationship, but her ghost returns to disrupt his impending nuptials.

Title: 92. Cinderfella
description: A gender-swapped retelling of Charles Perrault's classic, where Cinderfella is visited by a fairy godfather to help him escape from his wicked stepmother and stepbrothers.

Title: 93. Hideout in the Sun
description: Two brothers rob a bank and take a young woman hostage. They find out that the woman is a nudist, so they force her to take them to a nudist camp so they can hide out.

Title: 94. The Sundowners
description: In Australia's Outback during the early twentieth century, the impoverished Carmody family lives a nomadic life out of their wagon, but the mom and son want to settle, while the dad is against it.

Title: 95. Portrait in Black
description: After repressed wealthy Sheila Cabot and her physician lover Dr. David Rivera murder her cruel invalid husband Matthew, they are targeted by someone who is aware of their crime.

Title: 96. Too Young to Love
description: A court case ensues when a 47-year old man is caught with a 15-year old girl, and he claims he never knew she was so young.

Title: 97. The World of Suzie Wong
description: A businessman moves to Hong Kong to pursue a career as an artist and falls in love with a prostitute he hires as a model.

Title: 98. It Started in Naples
description: Days before his wedding, a Philadelphia lawyer travels to Naples in Southern Italy to settle the estate of his late brother, only to find that he has an Italian nephew who is being cared for by his maternal aunt, a cabaret singer.

Title: 99. The Two Faces of Dr. Jekyll
description: Dr. Henry Jekyll experiments with scientific means of revealing the hidden, dark side of man and releases a murderer from within himself.

Title: 100. The Facts of Life
description: Sophisticated comedy with Larry and Kitty leaving their spouses for an interlude together.

Title: 101. G.I. Blues
description: Tulsa McLean, a soldier with dreams of running his own nightclub, places a bet with his friend Dynamite that he can win the heart of an untouchable dancer. But when Dynamite is transferred, Tulsa must replace him in the bet.

Title: 102. Flaming Star
description: After fighting breaks out between two cultures in West Texas, the mixed-blood Pacer tries to act as a peacemaker, but the "flaming star of death" pulls him irrevocably into the deadly violence.

Title: 103. The Gallant Hours
description: A semi-documentary dramatization of five weeks in the life of Vice Admiral William F. "Bull" Halsey, Jr., from his assignment to command the U.S. naval operations in the South Pacific to the Allied victory at Guadalcanal.

Title: 104. The Bellboy
description: Mute bellboy Stanley works at the luxurious Fontainebleau Hotel in Miami Beach. In spite of being a serviceable and friendly employee, the clumsy Stanley gets successively into trouble with his mistakes.

Title: 105. The 1,000 Eyes of Dr. Mabuse
description: An American millionaire industrialist staying at the Luxor hotel in Berlin saves a woman from committing suicide. Unbeknownst to him, what follows is an intricate scheme being woven around him.

Title: 106. Pepe
description: The young Mexican Pepe's beloved horse is sold to Hollywood director Ted Holt, leading to Pepe's journey to Hollywood to get the horse back, and Pepe's encounter with half the stars working in Hollywood at the time.

Title: 107. Bell' Antonio
description: A newly wedded and extremely handsome young bourgeois Antonio faces a scandal in a city of Sicily in 1950's when the public and her family hears that his beautiful wife is still "untouched" after their 12-month long marriage.

Title: 108. Hell Bent for Leather
description: Mistaken for a murderous outlaw, an innocent horse trader is forced to go on the run to try and clear his name by catching the real culprit.

Title: 109. From the Terrace
description: An ambitious young executive chooses a loveless marriage and an unfulfilling personal life in exchange for a successful Wall Street career.

Title: 110. Zazie in the Metro
description: With her mother away for the weekend, a brash and precocious ten-year-old country girl sets out to explore Paris during a Métro strike under her uncle's not-so-watchful eye. But can a little girl cause so much chaos in the city centre?

Title: 111. The Story of Ruth
description: Moabitess priestess Ruth is drawn both to a Judean man and to his talk of a forgiving God. After tragedy strikes, she begins a new life in Bethlehem. Inspired by the Scriptural tale.

Title: 112. Beyond the Time Barrier
description: In 1960, a military test pilot becomes trapped in a time warp which transports him to the future, where he discovers a plague has sterilized the global population.

Title: 113. Satan's Sword
description: The story follows the life of Ryunosuke Tsukue, an amoral samurai and a master swordsman with an unorthodox style.

Title: 114. The 3 Worlds of Gulliver
description: After being shipwrecked, a man finds himself on an island inhabited by tiny people, who soon make plans for him.

Title: 115. The Vampire and the Ballerina
description: A troupe of beautiful young dancers find themselves stranded in a sinister, spooky old castle, not knowing that it is home to a group of vampires.

Title: 116. Kapo
description: A young Jewish girl leads an escape attempt from a concentration camp.

Title: 117. Sons and Lovers
description: A young man with artistic talent lives in a close-knit coal mining town and finds himself inhibited by his emotionally manipulative mother.

Title: 118. Tall Story
description: A young insecure college sportsman is in trouble. He wants to marry his very straightforward girlfriend, also a student, but has no money. After he is offered a bribe to fix a game, he is torn even more about the matter.

Title: 119. One Foot in Hell
description: In this Western, Alan Ladd exacts revenge on a small town the best way he knows how -- by becoming sheriff.

Title: 120. Strangers When We Meet
description: A suburban architect loves his wife but is bored with his marriage and with his work, so he takes up with the neglected, married beauty who lives down the street.

Title: 121. The Nudist Story
description: A young woman is appalled when she inherits a nudist camp, but she falls in love with the camp director, who has another secret admirer.

Title: 122. First Spaceship on Venus
description: When an alien artifact discovered on Earth is found to have come from Venus, an international team of astronauts embarks to investigate its origins.

Title: 123. Blood and Roses
description: A young heiress - jealous of her cousin's engagement to another woman - becomes obsessed with the legend of a vampire ancestor, who supposedly murdered the young brides of the man she loved.

Title: 124. Un rayo de luz
description: Carlos and Elena have secretly married. He belongs to a noble rich family, first son and heir of Italian count D'Angelo, and she is a poor, struggling actress and singer. After the wedding, he decides to tell his family about the marriage and flies to their home in Italy, but the plane crashes and he dies. When his brother Pablo goes to Spain to identify the body, he meets his now-widowed sister-in-law for the first time and discovers that she's pregnant. She asks only that the family finance the child's education. Years later, the child is now a little girl named Marisol, a sunshiny happy girl with a heart of gold and a melodious voice who is about to turn 10 years old. Her mother and uncle visit her at her boarding school in Malaga once a year before summer break. Her mother has told her that she is a rich, famous actress so Marisol would not be shy with her friends about her origins, but that means she can never take Marisol with her in the summer so that she never learns the truth. But Marisol's grandfather, count D'Angelo, who hates Elena for "stealing his son", wants to meet his granddaughter, so he asks Pablo to bring Marisol to Italy for the summer. When she arrives, the old man and his servants think she is a happiness-bringing angel. As the summer goes by, the old man comes to love her very much and starts feeling distressed over the thought of parting ways with her and starts planning to never send her back to Spain.

Title: 125. It Takes a Thief
description: A gang leader dumps her criminal boyfriend after he is convicted of robbery, but he recovers the stolen loot once he's released. In retaliation, the gang kidnaps his son and demands the money as ransom.

Title: 126. Kidnapped
description: In Scotland in 1751, young David Balfour is shanghaied aboard a ship where he meets Jacobite rebel Alan Breck Stewart with whom he escapes to the Scottish Highlands, dodging the redcoats.

Title: 127. Two Way Stretch
description: While in prison, Dodger plots the perfect heist: break out, steal diamonds, get back before noticed. With days left on his sentence and a solid alibi, he's confident nothing can go wrong.

Title: 128. Knights of the Teutonic Order
description: In the 15th century the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth is facing a hard struggle against the neighboring Teutonic Order.Frequent clashes between the two powers finally culminate in 1410 with the Battle of Grunwald.

Title: 129. Esther and the King
description: Esther Joan Collins, a Jew, comes to the attention of King Ahasuerus Richard Egan. The king has been trying to stifle and defeat the campaign of hatred fomented against the Jews by his evil minister Haman Sergio Fantoni.

Title: 130. Late Autumn
description: A widow tries to marry off her daughter with the help of her late husband's three friends.

Title: 131. Cruel Story of Youth
description: A harsh young man seduces a freeloading young woman and eventually takes advantage of her knack for hitch-hiking to rob middle-class men.

Title: 132. The House in Marsh Road
description: A novelist and his sexy lover plot to kill the novelist's wife so he can inherit her fortune including her house that happens to be haunted.

Title: 133. Heller in Pink Tights
description: Story of theatrical troupe that travels through the Old West.

Title: 134. Carry on Constable
description: With a flu epidemic running rife, three new bumbling recruits are assigned to Inspector Mills police station. They manage to totally wreck the operations of the police force and let plenty of criminals get away.

Title: 135. The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn
description: Mark Twain's 1851 story about two runaway friends, a fostered white boy and an escaped black slave, who sailed on a raft down the Mississippi River in search of freedom and adventure.

Title: 136. Ten Who Dared
description: Major John Wesley Powell leads an expedition through the Grand Canyon to chart the Colorado River.

Title: 137. Toby Tyler or Ten Weeks with a Circus
description: Taken in by distant members of his family after being orphaned, Toby Tyler runs away to join the circus.

Title: 138. Horrors of Spider Island
description: Survivors of a plane crash on a remote island find it is covered by spiders. When bitten, the survivors start turning into spiders!

Title: 139. Too Hot to Handle
description: A French reporter working on a steamy story about the secret strip joints found in London's Soho district becomes involved in the lives of the owner and star of a famous club.

Title: 140. The Good Girls
description: Four Parisian women navigate the world of romance and daily life looking to fulfill their dreams but often find real-life to be inescapable.

Title: 141. The Walking Target
description: An ex-con sets out to find the money which was hidden after a payroll robbery but is persuaded to turn it over to the police by his former accomplice's widow.

Title: 142. The Leech Woman
description: An endocrinologist in a dysfunctional marriage with an aging, alcoholic wife journeys to Africa seeking a drug that will restore youth.

Title: 143. Adua and Her Friends
description: When a brothel closes because of new laws, four of the prostitutes decide to go into business running a restaurant. They discover they cannot escape their past.

Title: 144. Sex Kittens Go to College
description: A striptease dancer becomes the head of the science department.

Title: 145. The Wild Ride
description: A rebellious punk of the beat generation spends his days as an amateur dirt track driver in between partying and troublemaking. He eventually kidnaps his buddy's girlfriend, kills a few police officers, and finally sees his own life end in tragedy.

Title: 146. The Human Vapor
description: A librarian undergoes a failed experiment, gaining vapor abilities. He robs banks to fund his dancer girlfriend's career, killing those who interfere. Now Tokyo's most wanted criminal, can authorities stop him before his next murder?

Title: 147. Never Let Go
description: A cosmetic salesman sets out to prove to himself and his wife that he is not a failure.

Title: 148. Last Woman on Earth
description: Ev, her husband Harold, and their friend Martin go scuba diving while on vacation in Puerto Rico. When they surface, they find that everyone on the island has died.

Title: 149. The Trials of Oscar Wilde
description: A chronicle of Oscar Wilde's libel suit against the Marquis of Queensberry and the tragic turn his life takes because of it.

Title: 150. Innocent Sorcerers
description: A womanizer is tired of being sought by women. One night he meets a young girl who all but forces herself into his room, where they talk of morals and love.

Title: 151. The Great Impostor
description: Ferdinand has always dreamt of doing anything he puts his mind to, no matter the obstacle. After dropping out of high school for being too smart, he embarks on a journey of impersonating various professionals, and excelling at their jobs.

Title: 152. All the Fine Young Cannibals
description: Salome, pregnant by Chad, runs away from her rural Texas home and marries wealthy Yale student Tony. Years later she runs into Chad, who is now a successful musician in New York.

Title: 153. High Time
description: Widower Harvey Howard enrolls in college at 51, insists on dorm life despite family disapproval. During this time, he participates in student life, develops feelings for Professor Helene Gauthier, but hesitates to remarry.

Title: 154. The Last Voyage
description: After a boiler explosion aboard an aging ocean liner, a man struggles to free his injured wife from the wreckage of their cabin and ensure the safety of their four-year-old daughter as the ship begins to sink.

Title: 155. The Millionairess
description: A millionairess and a doctor cannot marry until they meet conditions set up by their respective parents.

Title: 156. Messalina
description: Scheming Messalina marries Roman Emperor Claudius but goes too far with a gladiator.

Title: 157. Mill of the Stone Women
description: In 1800s Holland, a fine arts professor and an unlicensed surgeon run a lab where the former's daughter receives blood transfusions from kidnapped women who posthumously become macabre art.

Title: 158. A Breath of Scandal
description: Princess Olympia (Sophia Loren), despite her life status cannot resist the urge to satisfy her sexual appetites. Exiled to the countryside, Olympia falls in love with American millionaire Charlie Foster (John Gavin).

Title: 159. Who Was That Lady?
description: Ill-advised by his pal Mike Haney, chem teacher David Wilson falsely claims to be an undercover FBI agent to hide his infidelity. His jealous wife Ann swallows this lie, but it gets him in trouble with the real FBI, the CIA, and the KGB.

Title: 160. Cash McCall
description: James Garner put in a winning performance as a similarly unreconstructed capitalist in the grip of merger mania.

Title: 161. The Loves of Hercules
description: Hercules decides to avenge the death of his wife, murdered at the hands of Éurito, king of Ecalia, but everything is a plot of an ambitious courtier. Hercules ends up falling in love with Deyanira, who is now a good queen.

Title: 162. David and Goliath
description: King Saul of the Israelites is visited in Jerusalem by the Prophet Samuel who foretells him that a war with The Philistines is inevitable and the shepherd David will become king.

Title: 163. The Savage Innocents
description: An Inuit who has had little contact with white men goes to a trading post where he accidentally kills a missionary and finds himself being pursued by the police.

Title: 164. The Angry Silence
description: A young factory worker decides to stand up against his workmates and fellow union members when they want to hold a wildcat strike.

Title: 165. The Minotaur, the Wild Beast of Crete
description: A mythological hero attempts to rescue a princess from being sacrificed to a half-man, half-bull creature.

Title: 166. Seven Thieves
description: A motley crew of professional thieves plans the robbery of a Monte Carlo casino vault.

Title: 167. The Concrete Jungle
description: In the UK, after pulling a racetrack robbery, repeat offender Johnny Bannion hides the loot in a farmer's field but the police and the local mob come looking for Johnny and the money.

Title: 168. Hell Is a City
description: In Britain, a Manchester police inspector becomes obsessed with capturing a criminal who's escaped from prison.

Title: 169. The Revolt of the Slaves
description: During the later years of the Roman Empire, the daughter of a wealthy patrician falls in love with a Christian slave.

Title: 170. The Rat Race
description: An aspiring musician arrives in New York in search of fame and fortune. He soon meets a taxi dancer / call girl and moves in with her. Before long, a romance develops.

Title: 171. Wild for Kicks
description: An impetuous teenage girl becomes involved with Soho's beatnik and striptease scenes to spite her staid architect father and her French ex-stripper stepmother.

Title: 172. The Professionals
description: A career criminal and his gang plan to gain entry to a vault using the sewer system.

Title: 173. Everybody Go Home!
description: When Italy surrenders to the Allies, part of the Italian army is disbanded and soldiers begin to return to their homes.

Title: 174. Dinosaurus!
description: After undersea explosions near a Caribbean island, prehistoric creatures are unleashed on the population. A boy teams up with a Neanderthal and an irritated dinosaur, who try to stop the dinosaurs.

Title: 175. Wir Kellerkinder
description: A camera team is desperately searching for swastika graffiti. Finally they find a man willing to paint one -- on the window of his fathers nightclub. And he tells them also, how his father made a career between 33 and 45, while he helped to hide a communist, and then how he went into the lunatic asylum, while both - his father and the communist - made their careers after 1945.

Title: 176. The Dark at the Top of the Stairs
description: In Oklahoma in the 1920s, Rubin Flood (Robert Preston) loses his job as a travelling salesman after the company goes bankrupt. This adds to his worries at home. His wife Cora (Dorothy McGuire) is frigid because of trying to make ends meet. His teenage daughter Reenie (Shirley Knight) is afraid of going out on dates, but eventually makes friends with a troubled Jewish boy Sammy Golden (Lee Kinsolving), and his son Sonny is a mama's boy. Rubin finally storms out of the house after Cora falsely accuses him of having an affair with Mavis Pruitt (Dame Angela Lansbury).

Title: 177. Song Without End
description: The romantic story of Hungarian pianist Franz Liszt (Sir Dirk Bogarde), whose scandalous love affair forced him to abandon his adoring audiences.

Title: 178. The Mountain Road
description: A US Army Major stationed in East China in 1944 is ordered to blow up military installations in order to slow down the advancing Japanese Army.

Title: 179. The Delinquents
description: A bunch of scoundrels and members of the Spanish youth, who until now have not paid attention more than in the police stations. They are a group of friends who survive as they can in the suburbs of Madrid.

Title: 180. Seven Ways from Sundown
description: A Texas Ranger must capture an outlaw and take him in, while tangling with savage Apaches and greedy bounty hunters on the way back to jail.

Title: 181. I Bombed Pearl Harbor
description: Lt. Koji Kitami is a navigator-bombardier in Japan's Naval Air Force. He participates in the Japanese raid on the U.S. Naval Base at Pearl Harbor in 1941 and is welcomed with pride in his hometown on his return. As Japan racks up victory after victory in the Pacific War, Kitami is caught up in the emotion of the time and fights courageously for the standard of Japanese honor. But his assuredness of his government's righteousness is shaken after the Japanese navy is defeated in the debacle of Midway.

Title: 182. Stop Me Before I Kill!
description: After surviving a traumatic car accident, a race car driver travels to the Cote D'Azur to recover but is plagued by an urge to strangle his wife.

Title: 183. The Big Day
description: Three very different men compete for a top job; the result of the interviews comes as a surprise to everyone.

Title: 184. Holiday in Spain
description: Vacationing Englishman Oliver Larker stumbles upon a plot to kill a young American tourist in Spain.

Title: 185. The Playgirls and the Vampire
description: Five beautiful showgirls are trapped by a storm and find refuge in a creepy old castle. The owner of the castle, a strange nobleman, has a secret laboratory in the basement and has his own plans for the girls.

Title: 186. Tarzan the Magnificent
description: A clever crook and a romantic triangle complicate Tarzan's efforts to bring a wanted criminal to justice.

Title: 187. The Crowded Sky
description: Disaster movie about a Navy jet and a commercial airliner heading for a mid-air collision.

Title: 188. Mein Kampf
description: "Mein Kampf" presents the rise and fall of the Third Reich, showing mainly the destruction of Poland and the life of Hitler, from when he was a mediocre student and frustrated aspirant of art living in the slums of Austria and Germany, until his suicide in 1945 after being responsible for the deaths of millions of people and the destruction of Europe. All of the footage is real and was in a secret file of Göbbels, including many poignant scenes filmed by Göbbels himself.

Title: 189. Journey to the Lost City
description: "Journey to the Lost City" is not a specific film by Fritz Lang but the combination of The Tiger of Eschnapur (1959) with its sequel The Indian Tomb (1959), done in 1960 by American International Pictures.

Title: 190. Cómicos y canciones
description: The adventures of Viruta and Capulina: a reporter and a photographer, respectively, of a detective newspaper. Trying to obtain notoriety they interview a grim killer known as "El Tampico", and many more adventures.

Title: 191. 12 to the Moon
description: An international team embarks on an expedition to the moon in an uncommonly spacious rocketship. There they encounter a faceless alien intelligence who conclude that the human race is too immature and dangerous and must be destroyed.

Title: 192. When a Woman Ascends the Stairs
description: A middle-aged bar hostess, constantly in debt, is faced with numerous social constraints and challenges posed to her by her family, customers and friends.

Title: 193. La caperucita roja
description: The classic story of the Red Riding Hood spiced up by a couple of funny characters like the dog Duke, companion to the girl in her adventures, and the stinky Skunk, henchman to the Wolf.

Title: 194. I Passed for White
description: A young girl meets and marries the man of her dreams, never mentioning that she is half-Black.

Title: 195. The Private Lives of Adam and Eve
description: Eight travelers on a bus to Reno, Nevada have to stop overnight, where they have a dream about the Garden of Eden.

Title: 196. The Demon of Mount Oe
description: A team of samurai warriors team up to defeat a shape-changing, supernatural creature.

Title: 197. The Day They Robbed the Bank of England
description: In 1901, a group of IRA members decides to rob the Bank of England in order to finance their movement and to embarrass the British government.

Title: 198. Assignment: Outer Space
description: In the 22nd Century, Ray Peterson, reporter for the Interplanetary News, is assigned to write a story aboard a space station.

Title: 200. The Shakedown
description: A former pimp, released from prison, disregards his ex-cellmate's advice and reverts to criminal activities, this time involving a photographic model racket.

Title: 201. Seven Days... Seven Nights
description: A wealthy, bored woman witnesses a murder in affection and meets another witness. She asks him about the history of the victim and falls in love with him.

Title: 202. Wake Me When It's Over
description: Gus Brubaker has been drafted - again. Due to a clerical error, he finds himself deployed to a little Japanese island where everyone is bored to death. So, Gus decides to build a hotel and hire locals to run the place.

Title: 203. The Sinister Urge
description: A flunky for a porno-movie ring starts murdering the smut films' lead actresses.

Title: 204. Ice Palace
description: After WW1, Zeb and Thor start a cannery business in Alaska but eventually they drift apart with Zeb becoming unscrupulous and Thor getting involved in Alaskan politics.

Title: 205. Visit to a Small Planet
description: The weirdest alien of the galaxy pays a visit to Earth...

Title: 206. Sweet Deceptions
description: Francesca, a 17-year old school girl, has a vivid dream of making love to Enrico, a 37-year old divorced architect and family friend. She turns her dream into reality by meeting Enrico during a regular school day.

Title: 207. Daughters, Wives and a Mother
description: The story of a family in Tokyo who live under the same roof in a large house and include the widowed sixty-year-old mother, older son and his wife, the youngest daughter and the older daughter who, while being married, is experiencing domestic problems and has moved back in. The latter woman's husband soon dies however making the move permanent. With life insurance money flowing in she not only can afford to pay rent, but also loan some cash to her brother who unbeknownst to his mother has taken on a loan from the bank with the house as collateral. The loan was needed as his wife's aunt's factory needs an infusion of funds.

Title: 208. The Old Guard
description: Three old drinking buddies, accomplices and pranksters, decide to leave their village for a promising retirement home, walking through the countryside.

Title: 209. Make Mine Mink
description: A weird mix of social misfits and neighbors becomes a gang of thieves stealing mink coats in order to fund local charities.

Title: 210. The Amazing Transparent Man
description: A crazed scientist invents an invisibility formula. He plans to use the formula to create an army of invisible zombies.

Title: 211. Kala Bazar
description: A man sells movie tickets on the black market, but starts to have a change of heart after he falls in love.

Title: 212. The Battle of the Sexes
description: Angela Barrows, an accomplished business analyst from the US, attempts to contemporise the late Macpherson's tweed factory, shaking the very foundation of a men-only company.

Title: 213. Guns of the Timberland
description: Feud between ranchers and lumberjacks over the issue of environment protection versus profits.

Title: 214. Bombai Ka Babu
description: Childhood friends Babu and Malik take different paths after a youthful crime. While Malik becomes a police inspector, Babu turns to crime. Fleeing murder charges, he assumes a dead heir's identity, trapped between his past and new family.

Title: 215. The Subterraneans
description: A love story between two misunderstood new bohemians who don't even understand themselves.

Title: 216. All the Young Men
description: During the Korean War, a platoon leader dies, leaving his inexperienced Black sergeant in charge of his squad of belligerent and racist white men.

Title: 217. The Night Fighters
description: In 1941, the IRA plans a campaign to coincide with the planned German invasion of England. Dermot O'Neill finds it easy to get into the IRA, but can he get out?

Title: 218. Four Fast Guns
description: In 1873, the town of Purgatory hires a town-tamer, but the evil saloon owner hires three gunfighters to kill him.

Title: 219. The Tell-Tale Heart
description: A man murders the lover of the woman he is obsessed with, then is driven insane with guilt.

Title: 220. Inspector Palmu's Error
description: A closed room mystery begins when an infamous tycoon is found dead in his bath tub. The famous police lieutenant Palmu is summoned to investigate.

Title: 221. A Dog of Flanders
description: The emotional story of a boy, his grandfather, and his dog. The boy's dream of becoming a great classical painter appears shattered after his loving grandfather dies.

Title: 222. The Red Circle
description: A strange, red circle appears on the neck of a man saved from the guillotine. What is its mysterious meaning? Tragically, it turns out to be something of a family curse, as each generation thereafter bears the same sign, which in turn leads to blackmail and murder.

Title: 223. Twelve Hours to Kill
description: Based on the Saturday Evening Post serial "Set Up For Murder" by Richard Stern, the story traces the problems of a young Greek national (Nico Minardos) who, after witnessing a murder, is ushered off into the relative safety of suburban obscurity by the police, unaware that he is being double-crossed by a crooked cop.

Title: 224. Primary
description: Cinéma vérité feature that follows presidential hopefuls John F. Kennedy and Hubert H. Humphrey during the 1960 Wisconsin primary.

Title: 225. Sunrise at Campobello
description: After a bout with polio, future president Franklin D. Roosevelt fights to save his political career.

Title: 226. Man on a String
description: A US secret agent is sent to Berlin to pretend that he's a spy for the USSR.

Title: 227. Atom Age Vampire
description: An exotic dancer is disfigured in a car accident. A scientist develops a treatment that restores her beauty. To preserve her appearance the doctor must give her additional treatments using glands taken from murdered women.

Title: 228. A Touch of Larceny
description: Royal Navy Commander Max Easton fakes his defection to the Soviets in order to sue the slandering newspapers for the money he needs to woo a fancy American woman.

Title: 229. Because They're Young
description: A new high-school teacher tries to help troubled students and falls in love with the principal's secretary.

Title: 230. Rocket Attack U.S.A.
description: An American secret agent tries to stop the Soviets from launching an intercontinental missile at the mainland United States.

Title: 231. It Happened in '43
description: In the midst of World War II, the story of the affair of a young woman married to a man in a wheelchair, with a deserter from the Italian army, intertwines with that of the power grab of a fanatical local fascist leader who gets the hold with a massacre of Pacific opposition, among them the young deserter's father. Oppressive fog covers both dramas as a reminder of how values such as courage, love, and truth are fading.

Title: 232. Conspiracy of Hearts
description: Catholic nuns risk their lives to help Jewish children in an Italian internment camp escape to Palestine during World War II.

Title: 233. Inn for Trouble
description: After a couple from London move to the country to take over a pub they have inherited, they find that rural life isn't as idyllic as they'd imagined, thanks to the maneuverings of a powerful local brewery.

Title: 234. The Giants of Thessaly
description: In order to placate the angry gods, who have allowed Thessaly to be overrun with barbarian invaders and beset with natural disasters, King Jason takes his Argonauts on a search for the fabled Golden Fleece. Meanwhile, back at home, his scheming regent is plotting to get his hands on the kingdom--and the queen.

Title: 235. Too Soon to Love
description: Unmarried teenage lovers turn to desperate measures after their clandestine tryst results in an unplanned pregnancy.

Title: 236. The Orphan
description: When a young street thug becomes friends with the headmaster of a school, he gives up the triad life to enroll in the school.

Title: 237. Satan's Sword II
description: Ryunosuke awakens in the forest having no more idea what happened that previous night, as he'd been drunk & hallucinatory. He is surrounded by corpses & can surmise it's his own handiwork.

Title: 238. Brainwashed
description: In 1938 Austria shortly after the Nazi occupation, a prominent Viennese intellectual, Werner von Basil, is arrested for smuggling art treasures out of the country, and imprisoned by the Gestapo in a hotel room - without any mental sustenance of any kind - to break him down and make him talk. A young ballerina named Irene Andreny, who is the lover of the SS officer Berger playing mind games on von Basil, tries to intervene and help the poor intellectual keep his mind intact.

Title: 239. Wild Youth
description: Three teenage criminals break out of juvenile prison and head south to Mexico.

Title: 240. The White Dove
description: A poetic film about a dove getting lost on its way to Prague getting shot down by a paralyzed boy. An artist who finds the dove becomes friends with the boy. Together they take care of it bringing it back to recovery.

Title: 241. The Fiend of Dope Island
description: A nightclub entertainer and the man she truly loves conspire to end a black-marketeer's tyrannic rule.

Title: 242. Jazz Boat
description: An electrician is summoned to assist a gang in a big robbery.

Title: 243. Key Witness
description: In Los Angeles, a brave witness to murder agrees to testify in court against the street gang leader who's desperate to silence him.

Title: 244. The Warrior Empress
description: He-man Phaon impresses Sappho of Lesbos at the temple of Aphrodite, circa 600 B.C.

Title: 245. Night Train for Inverness
description: An ex-convict kidnaps his 7-year-old son and takes him on a train to Inverness, unaware he is putting his son's health in danger.

Title: 246. Pay or Die!
description: Between 1906-1909, NYPD Lieutenant Joe Petrosino heads the Italian Squad and tries to stamp out organized crime from the city, often times amid assassination attempts by the Mafia.

Title: 247. Walk Like a Dragon
description: In 1870s California, cowboy Lincoln 'Linc' Bartlett finds out there's a slave auction of Chinese women in San Francisco and he intervenes and purchases Kim Sung from the auction with the intent of setting her free. But it doesn't occur to Linc that setting her free isn't enough. Where will she go? Kim doesn't speak English and she will just be exploited by somebody else. Linc takes Kim home to serve as a housekeeper. Ma Bartlett, Linc's mother, is not happy that a Chinese girl is living in her home, and even less happy when Kim and her son fall in love. Their affair also arouses the jealousy of Cheng Lu, a Chinese immigrant.

Title: 249. High School Caesar
description: Matt Stevens is the big man at high school. He sweats the students for protection money, acquires copies of tests for a fee, and has rigged the votes so he can beat Kelly in the election for student president.

Title: 250. 5 Branded Women
description: Five Yugoslav women who consorted with the German occupiers are publicly humiliated and banished by the Yugoslav partisans, but they take up arms to fend for themselves.

Title: 251. The Pure Hell of St. Trinian's
description: The hellions of St. Trinians are recruited to a sheik's harem. Little does he know what he's letting himself in for.

Title: 252. The Girl in Lovers Lane
description: Two drifters contend with love and murder in a small town.

Title: 253. The Good Soldier Schweik
description: During World War I, Schweik (played by Heinz Rühmann) is drafted into the Austro-Hungarian Army as soldier, where he is assigned to be an assistent to Lt. Lukas.

Title: 254. Trouble in the Sky
description: In Britain, at the dawn of jet-powered commercial aviation, an aircraft manufacturer tries to shift the blame from mechanical failure to pilot error when its newest jet airliner has a series of accidents.

Title: 255. The Bulldog Breed
description: Jilted and disappointed in love, grocer's assistant Norman Puckle joins the Navy where he is recruited to man the first British rocket.

Title: 257. Escape by Night
description: During the Second World War three allied prisoners: a Soviet, an American, and an Englishman, attempt to escape Rome with the help of a young couple who are residents of the city.

Title: 258. Once More, with Feeling!
description: Victor Fabian, a musical genius, faces a career setback after his wife discovers he's auditioning a sultry pianist, forcing him to regain his wife's respect.

Title: 259. Surprise Package
description: An American gangster is exiled from the United States for criminal activity and is sent back to the Greek island where he was born. Once on the island, he is watched by a corrupt local police chief. Upon meeting an exiled king, he attempts to purchase the king's family jewels for a million dollars. However, when he wires for the money to his associates back home, they double cross him and send him a beautiful gun moll instead.

Title: 260. Circle of Deception
description: Unbeknownst to him, a soldier is sent on a doomed mission because of the high likelihood of him divulging secrets if captured and tortured.

Title: 261. The Baroness from the Gas Station
description: A baron dies. His unknown offspring, 20-year-old Anne, a mechanic at the local gas station, is heiress to a a huge estate and title. Will she get along with the baron's mom and transform from tomboy to lady?

Title: 262. Kanoon
description: A lawyer holds the eyewitness evidence to catch a killer, but the identified criminal is the lawyer's own mentor, prospective father-in-law, and also the judge who presides over the case.

Title: 263. Love and Larceny
description: Gerardo, an aspiring theater actor, is roped into performing a scam but gets double crossed by his partner and goes to prison. After prison, he turns into a successful con artist using his ability to mimic different Italian dialects.

Title: 264. Studs Lonigan
description: A young man tries to escape the South Side of 1920s Chicago.

Title: 265. Goliath and the Dragon
description: A warrior returning home to his country must battle giant bats, three-headed dogs and a vicious dragon to save his wife and his people from the machinations of an evil ruler.

Title: 266. Virgin Sacrifice
description: A white hunter in South America falls in love with a native girl and must save her from becoming a virgin sacrifice.

Title: 267. Pretty Boy Floyd
description: Charles Arthur Floyd finds work on an oil rig after serving time for armed robbery; but when he becomes involved with a married woman, her husband swears revenge. Floyd's boss doesn't know that his new employee was a jailbird.

Title: 268. Captain Blood
description: The young King Louis XIII is dominated by his mother Marie de Medici and her favorite Concino Concini. Francois de Capestang, a faithful knight falls for the daughter of the Duke of Angouleme that conspires against the Crown by his side.

Title: 269. The Lady with the Dog
description: A love story among the nobility of the Russian Empire: a man and a woman, both married, fall in love.

Title: 270. L'Eau à la bouche
description: Miléna is living in her grandmother's baroque château when the rich lady dies. The lawyer Miguel, who had a previous relationship with Miléna, insists the other two grandchildren, Fifine and her brother Jean-Paul, visit the château for the reading of the will, even though they have been estranged from the family at an early age. However Robert, who had been living with Fifine in an open relationship, arrives and impersonates Jean-Paul. Robert falls for Fifine's cousin Miléna while Fifine has designs on Miguel. In the meantime, the butler César is focusing his lecherous intentions on Prudence, the maid he had just hired.

Title: 271. Colossus and the Amazon Queen
description: Two musclemen come up against a tribe of Amazon women.

Title: 272. Morgan the Pirate
description: A Welsh pirate raids up and down the Caribbean, battling the Spanish, the English and other pirates.

Title: 273. Not Tonight Henry
description: Hank Henry is more than a little frustrated at the lack of attention he is getting from his wife and starts dreaming up amorous escapades with sirens from the past.

Title: 274. The Barbarians
description: Revak is an Iberian prince from Penda, a small island where the Carthagian fleet ransacked and enslaved the surviving native men, including him. After an eventful passage aboard a galley, Revak becomes an elephant driver in Carthage city, and could become the favorite of mighty women, but has only one thirst: bloody revenge, at all cost, so the barbarian makes common cause with the attacking Romans, Carthage's historical enemy and rival for Mediterranean hegemony, scorning love...

Title: 275. The Ship of Monsters
description: Two extraterrestrial women are sent on a mission by the regent of Venus to search for a male of another planet.

Title: 276. Rumpelstiltskin
description: Once upon a time, there lived a lazy miller who spent all his time drinking wine and telling stories. When the king's treasurer comes to him with a demand to pay the tax, the miller lies that his daughter Marie can spin gold from straw.

Title: 277. Brother
description: Set in 1926 when Japanese tradition was much stronger, this standard drama looks at the inner workings of a small family, especially the relationship between a sister and brother.

Title: 278. Ghunghat
description: Ravi's parents asks him to marry someone else rather then is love Laxmi for the sake of his father.After the wedding they travel in a train which has newly married couples the train meets with a disastrous accident.Ravi sees an unconscious bride lying next to him and takes her home but finds that his wife died in the accident and the bride whom he bought home is Parvati.Ravi decides to find her husband Gopal but before that Parvati finds the truth and escapes from the house.Parvati falls into the river Jamuna and lands in house of Gopal where here brother Manohar to comes who has lost his eyesight after the accident.But Parvati cant disclose he identity to Gopal nor Manohar.

Title: 279. College Confidential
description: Sociology prof's survey on youth lifestyle raises hackles when sex questions surface; reporter gets anonymous tip, prof's past emerges.

Title: 280. Quinceañera
description: Three girls at boarding school share a birthday, and plan for their Quinceañeras. Beatriz, however, is a scholarship student whose parents cannot afford a fancy ball, so her friends invite her to theirs.

Title: 281. Le bel âge
description: Paris ,Spring :Jacques ,38 , has just broken up with the beautiful Alexandra.He has bitter memories and he begins to deludes himself.A few months later,in Saint-Tropez ,he watches,amused, his friend Claude 's love failures with Anne,Alexandra ,Barbara and Ursula.Three months later the four girls welcome both men and another guy,Lucien ,in their chalet in the mountain.Virginie,a coquette, gets involved in the amorous game and confuses the issue.

Title: 282. The Plunderers
description: After four rowdy cowhands ride into a small town and make trouble, no one seems willing or able to take them on, not even Sam Christy, the toughest man in town. But then there is a murder.

Title: 283. Kohinoor
description: Princess Chandramukhi falls in love with King Dhivendra when he rescues her from thugs. However, her life gets complex when she gets captured by an evil general and must marry him to save Dhivendra.

Title: 284. The 3rd Voice
description: The bitter secretary of a businessman plans to murder him and replace him with a hired look-alike accomplice in order to drain the company's bank accounts.

Title: 285. Alakazam the Great
description: An arrogant monkey is forced to go on a journey where he learns about gluttony, greed, love and humility.

Title: 286. Date Bait
description: Brad returns from rehab and fights Logan over Sue at a club. Brad's brother beats Logan later. Sue secretly marries Logan despite her father's disapproval. Brad becomes obsessed with Sue and relapses into drugs.

Title: 287. The Wandering Princess
description: A film adaptation of the autobiography of Aishinkakura Hiro, who lived a tumultuous life as the consort of Fuketsu, the younger brother of Emperor Puyi of Manchukuo.

Title: 288. The Hand
description: A Police Inspector follows the trail and circumstances of the murder of a one-handed man back to a prisoner-of-war camp in Burma in 1946.

Title: 289. Stowaway in the Sky
description: A young boy sneaks onto his grandfather's hot-air balloon and together they travel over France.

Title: 290. Zlé pondelí
description: Three nine-year-old boys caused their classmate to end up under the wheels of a truck. How do you confess to what happened? Adults don't have the time or for selfish reasons don't want to deal seriously with children's problems.

Title: 291. Pirates of the Coast
description: (1960) Lex Barker, Estella Blain, Livion Lorenzon, Liana Orfei. A great, colorful Italian costume epic with Barker as a ship captain who is pitted against a crafty pirates. There are some interesting turnabouts, however, with plot twists a-plenty. Beautiful photography. Color, 16mm.

Title: 292. Thunder in Carolina
description: Professional stock car racer Mitch Cooper wrecks his car and hurts his ankle in a brutal smash-up. Mitch takes time off from racing to teach cocky eager beaver kid Les York how to drive well on the track. Mitch also takes a fancy to York's lovely, no-nonsense wife Rene. This leads to York ditching Mitch as his manager so he can race for some evil jerk millionaire who only cares about winning.

Title: 293. Füre lépni szabad
description: Taking advantage of a thoughtless offer, the Kárász family move in with the Kéri family. While the parents fight each other, the young people fall in love.

Title: 294. The Beginning and the End
description: After the death of the father, the family consisting of a mother and two young men and a girl themselves without a breadwinner finds, to begin each of them in the direction to a different path, to err on the older brother (Hassan) to work drug, and graduated (Hussein) East of the Police College, while working (Nafisa) prostitution without the knowledge family, to hide them from the fate of many surprises.

Title: 295. Platinum High School
description: At an exclusive military academy on Sabre Island (played by Catalina Island), rich young delinquents think money puts them above the law. Enter Steven Conway (Mickey Rooney) - there to investigate the death of his son, whom he had been told died in an accident. He finds quickly himself in 5 feet of trouble (over his eyebrows), when he's met with hostility by the school's commandant, Major Redfern Kelly (Dan Duryea), and the latter's sweetheart-secretary, Jennifer Evans (Terry Moore); he's also intimidated by the cadet drill instructor, Vince Perley (Christopher Dark), and the P.E. instructor, Hack Marlow (Richard Jaeckel). Attempts are made on his life by a trio of cadets, known collectively as "the 3 beasts", and he's trapped in a 3-against-1 fight with rifles. Just to keep him tested, there's a big speedboat vs. small motorboat (Rooney's craft of course) chase through shark-infested waters. This happens right after he makes a startling discovery when he talks to his son's former roommate, 'Crip' Hastings (Warren Berlinger). The film was re-released in 1964 as "Trouble at Sixteen", by Cinema Associates as part of a double bill with Girls Town (1959) (now called The Innocent and the Damned, a rather descriptive title; considering the cast).

Title: 296. The Approach of Autumn
description: Single mum (father of child dead) from the country with 6th grade boy comes to Tokyo, leaves the boy to live with his uncle's family - wife, male, female teens, run a struggling greengrocer - and lives/ works in local inn. He gets bullied/ fights with local boys, goes to the baths, plays basketball, is befriended by his male cousin and becomes friendly with grade 4 girl who's the daughter of the innkeeper, who employs his mum and is the longterm mistress of a businessman from another town, who's the girl's father and who brings her half sister and brother to meet her but they're mean to her. Meanwhile the boy's mother gets friendly with one of the inn's clients and chucks her job for a trip or something more permanent with him. The young girl takes him shopping, and wants the boy to live with her and her mother, but mother and father refuse so the two kids go to a seaside where he sprains his ankle and they're late back even though the police get them and they're in trouble. The boy loses his beetle and tries to get another for the girl for a school project but when he does, she's moved house with her mother at the urging of her father. Clear? It's better in the film.

Title: 297. The Ninth Circle
description: In order to save a Jewish girl from the Nazis and their colaborators, a Croatian family arranges her to be wed to their young son. The son is displeased with sudden end to his careless youth and he doesn't seem to like the girl or the whole idea. However, when she gets caught in a street raid, it is too late - he must face the fact that he loves her. The man starts looking for her, even if it means that he would go to the very center of concentration camp - the Ninth Circle.

Title: 298. Skywatch
description: A comedy drama set in a WWII British Army Searchlight Squad. They are an odd bunch of misfits but somehow manage to get the job done.

Title: 299. The Army Game
description: Jean Lerat de la Grignotière is as full of himself as his name is long. Heeding (somewhat reluctantly to be true) the call of the Motherland he goes to the barracks where he is to accomplish his military duty. Posted to Corporal Bourrache's platoon he is surprised to meet there...Joseph, his own servant. Making blunder after blunder Jean gets hazed by his comrades and punished by his officers while Joseph's adaptation to military life is as smooth as can be. All this does not prevent the young snob from courting Catherine, the colonel's daughter, not very successfully at the beginning. Things start shaping better when he accepts to play a part in "Tire-au-flanc", Mouëzy-Eon's famed comedy. Interpreting the servant while Joseph plays his master, the successful beginner at long last becomes popular among the other soldiers and gets Catherine's hand as a bonus.

Title: 300. Afraid to Die
description: Takeo is a young yakuza who renounces his former criminal activities after being released from prison. But sometimes escaping the past is not so easy.

Title: 301. La sombra del Caudillo
description: The movie situated in post-revolutionary Mexico describes the way politics were done in those times. Ignacio Jimenez is chosen as the candidate of the Partido Radical Progresista, but he isn't so sure about it, because he knows his boss,El Caudillo has chosen another candidate. Several political moves are done between the parties, leading to a thunderous climax.

Title: 302. The Haunted Castle
description: The ghosts of thieves help a beautiful young countess save her inherited castle from modern developers in this comic horror/musical.

Title: 303. Snowball
description: A boy claims he was thrown off the school bus by the conductor, obliging him to walk several miles home. Alerted by the boy's neighbor, the local press makes an issue of the incident - with tragic repercussions.

Title: 304. Dil Apna Aur Preet Parai
description: A dedicated surgeon is obligated to marry the daughter of a family friend, but his heart belongs to the nurse who works tirelessly by his side.

Title: 305. Under Ten Flags
description: German raider, using various disguises, forces British ship to surrender. Story told from German point of view.

Title: 306. Half Way to Hell
description: Two women, Maria and Joanne cross the Mexican border into the United States to escape Mexico's authoritarian government. Their escape is foiled by bounty hunters, along with a band of men working for Joanne's ex lover, Escobar.

Title: 308. The Adventures of Buratino
description: A colorful fairy tale about a little wooden boy Buratino and his quest for the Golden Key that opens a secret door.

Title: 309. Son of Samson
description: Maciste travels to Egypt, where he leads a revolt against an evil queen.

Title: 310. Desire in the Dust
description: Lonnie Wilson, the son of a toothless sharecropper, Zuba Wilson, returns to his small southern hometown after spending six years on the chain gang for killing Colonel Ben Marquand's son in an automobile accident. He revives his love affair with Melinda Marquand, who is now Mrs. Melinda Thomas, since she married Dr. Ned Thomas, while Lonnie was serving time, in her place, for the accident she caused. Somewhat miffed about all this, Lonnie incites Dr. Ned about his wife's infidelity, which he verifies when he catches Lonnie and Melinda in a semi-torrid embrace in Colonel Marquand's hunting lodge. Melinda, looking for an explanation for this situation, shoots and wounds Lonnie to defend her innocence by claiming she was being raped. Colonel Marquand, who had bribed Lonnie to take the blame for his daughter, uses her story to try and have Sheriff Wheaton kill Lonnie, and put an end to all this mess. But there is another reel or two before this all ends.

Title: 311. Moment of Danger
description: A jewel thief pulls off a big heist, stabs his partner-in-crime in the back, dumps his girlfriend and goes on the run with the loot. The ex-partner and the girlfriend team up to go after him.

Title: 312. Serge
description: The mother of a 5 years old Seryozha remarries. This man becomes a friend and a confident, an adult who see Seryozha not as a child, but as a person.

Title: 313. Doctor in Love
description: Doctors Burke and Hare depart St. Swithin's for general practice. They visit Foulness anti-cold Unit as patients. Hare joins an upscale GP office, while Burke explores various medical positions.

Title: 314. The Terrible People
description: A creepy German-made Wallace thriller about the ghost of a hanged man who returns to fulfill his promise. All of his accusers must die.

Title: 315. The Spider's Web
description: After an intruder is killed in her house, the comfortable life of Clarissa Hailsham-Brown is turned upside-down.

Title: 316. Third Side of the Coin
description: A documentary about the then only twelve year old country of Israel, caught amidst the tensions of the Middle East and the ongoing Cold War.

Title: 317. Lipstick
description: Twelve-year-old Silvana De Carli falls in love with 30-year-old Gino.

Title: 318. Take Aim at the Police Van
description: A prison truck is assaulted and the two convicts inside are murdered. The prison guard on duty gets suspended for negligence and takes it upon himself to track down the killers.

Title: 319. Il vigile
description: An unemployed man gets a job as traffic policeman but the traffic in the big city creates innumerous problems for the poor guy.

Title: 320. September Storm
description: A young, handsome man works on the yacht of a Parisian tycoon who happens to be away at the moment. Two nautical layabouts convince him to take them out looking for a sunken treasure.

Title: 321. The Siege of Sidney Street
description: As armed police surround a house in the East End of London, a young lady under medical supervision nearby thinks back to the events that led her and a group of refugee Russian political anarchists to this situation.

Title: 322. El cochecito
description: Seventy-something Don Anselmo, a retired minister, becomes obsessed with owning a motorized wheelchair and fakes infirmity to get it.

Title: 323. Silver Spoon Set
description: An acid portrait of Italian youth at the time, I DELFINI follows a dreary season of discontent and viciousness in the lives of a thoroughly unpleasant group of mostly rich youngsters in a small Adriatic coast city.

Title: 324. The Bramble Bush
description: A handsome and successful young doctor returns to his home town in New England to see his dying friend for one last time. However, his friend wants to die because he is suffering so much from his illness, and he manages to convince the doctor to commit euthanasia (a mercy killing) on him. Haunted by what he has done, and troubled further still by other dark secrets from his past, the doctor seeks comfort in the arms of several of the town's lustful women. This leads to even more complications in his life...

Title: 325. Madalena
description: A tenacious daughter and an expert boatman are more than eager to prolong their parents' irreconcilable feud. However, an untimely demise will only make things worse. Can a humble priest help them bury the hatchet and, maybe, find love?

Title: 326. Girl of the Night
description: "Girl of the Night" is about Bobbie (Anne Francis), a sensitive, lonely call girl who is manipulated and ultimately used by her madame, played by Kay Medford.

Title: 327. Love, the Italian Way
description: A group of passengers traveling around the Mediterranean on a luxury liner enjoy various adventures and become romantically involved with each other.

Title: 328. Oscar Wilde
description: Playwright Oscar Wilde's homosexuality is exposed when he brings a libel action against his lover's father, leading to his own prosecution.

Title: 329. Night and Fog in Japan
description: Long takes and a highly theatrical visual approach combine to form a tense and confrontational look at the decline of a socialist student activists' movement in Japan.

Title: 330. Black Tights
description: Live scenes of Paris and a continuity Narrator link together four dramatic re-enactments of original ballet creations by Roland Petit and his ensemble, Ballets de Paris: Carmen (1949), La croqueuse de diamants (1950), Deuil en 24 heures (1953), and Cyrano de Bergerac (1959).

Title: 331. When Darkness Falls
description: Young Elisabeth comes to Västlinge to meet her old relative, the vicar and and his young daughter. She is going to spend the Christmas there in peace and quiet but on Christmas Eve, the grocer is brutally murdered with an axe. Police inspector Christer Wijk comes to the small village to find the murderer. He soon discovers the puzzle of evidence that makes almost everybody a suspect.

Title: 332. Higher Principle
description: The story of High school in Czechia (then Protectorate Bohemia and Moravia) during occupation by Nazi Germany, where three students are arrested by Gestapo.

Title: 333. Maribel y la extraña familia
description: Marcelino's earnest wish is to marry Maribel, a former prostitute. When she gets to know his elderly mother and aunt, however, strange things concerning Marcelino's first wife start to arise.

Title: 334. Faust
description: The aging scientist Faust is desperately in search of knowledge and insight, but without success. To escape from this ignorance, he dares the extreme: He joins forces with The Devil. Mephisto offers him eternal youth and the opportunity to seduce the virgin Gretchen.

Title: 335. Squad Car
description: An accused man helps a policeman investigate an airplane mechanic's death and a counterfeit racket.

Title: 336. Foxhole in Cairo
description: A German Agent in Libya is allowed to get back to Rommel with false information.

Title: 337. There Was a Crooked Man
description: Davy Cooper is a law-abiding but down on his luck explosives expert. A chance meeting with a former comrade leads the naive Cooper into a world of crime and ultimately prison. Upon his release, the chance to make amends presents itself.

Title: 338. Chaudhvin Ka Chand
description: Aslam and Nawab fall in love with the same girl, Jameela because of which misunderstandings arise between the friends.

Title: 339. From a Roman Balcony
description: The ironic study of a young man's poignant and sensual adventures based on "Roman Tales" by Alberto Moravia.

Title: 340. A French Mistress
description: The boys of Melbury Primary School are plunged into turmoil after the new French master turns out to be a mistress. Madeleine Lafarge's (the French mistress) effect on the boys is swift and amazing. Suddenly, everyone wants extra French Lessons just to glimpse the teacher in revealing shorts and bikinis. As discipline crumbles, a scandal explodes after the Head discovers the mademoiselle's mother was an old flame. Madeleine must be dismissed to save further embarrassments. But the boys take strike action to stop this from happening in a breezy comedy with plenty of ooh la la.

Title: 341. The Warped Ones
description: A juvenile delinquent gets out of the pen and causes reckless mayhem, mostly directed at the girlfriend of the journalist who helped send him up.

Title: 342. Bottoms Up
description: Jimmy Edwards reprises his TV and radio role as the Professor trying to control a school full of naughty boys.

Title: 343. The Boy and the Pirates
description: A young boy is magically transported back in time to a pirate ship on the high seas.

Title: 344. Crack in the Mirror
description: Three performers in six roles in a melodrama about two love triangles. In the first, Hagolin is killed by his mistress and her lover. In the second, attorney Lamerciere discovers his woman would like to elope with his assistant. During the trial against two murderer/lovers, the attorney agrees to a minor sentence for them.

Title: 345. The Sun's Burial
description: In Osaka's slum, capricious folks without futures engage in pilfering, assault and robbery, prostitution, and the trading of ID cards and blood.

Title: 346. Anuradha
description: A lonely housewife, who gave up her promising singing career to marry an idealistic village-doctor, begins to regret her decision.

Title: 347. Three Came to Kill
description: Three professional killers break into the house of an airport employee to shoot the plane on which an Asian Prime Minister is due to leave America.

Title: 348. The White Horse Inn
description: In the white Rössl.

Title: 349. The Risk
description: UK scientists find a cure for plague but their government, fearing its military-biological potential, keeps the discovery secret until a scientist is duped into giving it to a foreign power.

Title: 350. The River of Love
description: Nahr el Hub is the Egyptian adaptation of Leo Tolstoy's "Anna Karenina". Nawal, a rural girl, is married off to a wealthy aristocrat called Taher Basha (Zaki Rostom). Nawal gets increasingly depressed due to her husband's cold, cruel demeanor, despite their lavish life.
