When Suresh dies in an accident, a michievious neighbour (Madan Puri) spreads rumours about the judge living in sin with Ranjana. Ranjana decides that Mehta should re-marry in order to silence the slanders and her younger sister Shobha (Kumkum) comes to the rescue.

Title: 625. Miya Bibi Razi
description: Fakirchand lives a wealthy lifestyle along with his wife, Lakshmi; a daughter named Kamla, and two sons, Raja, who attends college, and Ratan, who is in school. Kamla is an activist against the social evil of dowry, and works as a school-teacher. When the school upgrades it's building, they hire an engineer, Kumar, and both Kamla and Kamla fall in love with each other. Kumar lives a middle-class lifestyle with his widower dad, Dhaniram, and two sisters, Rajni, who attends college, and Munni, who is school-going. Rajni is in love with Raja and both plan to get married soon, but are also aware that Fakirchand expects a Dowry of at least Twenty Thousand Rupees. When Dhaniram finds out that Rajni has fallen in love with Raja, he goes to meet with Fakirchand, who insults and humiliates him. When Fakirchand finds out that Kamla wants to wed Kumar, he goes to Dhaniram, and he, in turn, gets humiliated. When Dhaniram finds out that Kumar loves Kamla, he approaches Fakirchand and apologizes, but Fakirchand insults him all the more so much so that Dhaniram forbids both Kumar and Rajni from seeing Kamla and Raja respectively. While at the other end a livid Fakirchand also forbids Kamla and Raja from seeing Kumar and Rajni respectively. By the looks of things only a miraculous intervention could bring the two foes together before acrimony spreads to the four lovebirds, who are also well on their way to avoid meeting each other at any and all costs.

Title: 626. La contessa azzurra
description: Loreley looks back to the happy times when she became a silent movie star.

Title: 627. The Iron Mask
description: A woman and her sister are prisioners in their own hacienda. A masked man called El ranchero solitario fights against a human-bat vampire.

Title: 629. Agent Shiranui
description: Before he portrayed the legendary blind swordsman, Zatoichi, Shintaro Katsu played Suganoichi, a blind court masseur with a dark side. An outcast since birth, he learned from a young age that the only way to get ahead was to take advantage of others. Now an expert con-artist with a heart of coal, Suganoichi is on a vile quest for power, and everyone else will suffer along the way!

Title: 630. Bhakta Kanakadasa
description: The spiritual journey of Kanakadasa, a poet and a philosopher belonging to the Dasa sect during the 16th century when the stone idol of Lord Krishna turns around as he's being punished for wanting to see the Lord's statue in Udupi.

Title: 631. Ranadheera Kanteerava
description: Kanthirava Narasaraja I, the young king of the Kingdom of Mysore, finds himself mired in politics and conspiracy. Under the guidance of his mother, he learns the ways and rises to power.

Title: 632. Cruise to Rhodes
description: A bankrupt businessman goes on vacation to Rhodes, pretending to be a shipowner, to find a wealthy bride and recover financially.

Title: 633. Wild Roots of Love
description: Four little girls flee the cold concrete world of the housing project they live in, take refuge every evening in a house on an island in the middle of the Marne River. It is secret hideaway that no one should trespass. Unfortunately a big girl reveals everything to the schoolmistress and scandal breaks out. But it is Sophie, the youngest of the group, who gets suspected by her..."friends".

Title: 634. Endstation Rote Laterne
description: Unscrupulous girl traders transport unsuspecting blonde girls from a nightclub in Amsterdam to a brothel in Havana. The young journalist Verena Linkmann wants to expose the slave trade, disguises herself as an available dancer.

Title: 635. Seilergasse 8
description: A homicide investigator suspects his own son of murder.

Title: 636. Un americano en Toledo
description: A professor of philology from Toledo (Ohio, United States), travels to Toledo (Spain) to improve his Castilian. There he will meet an attractive painter and his peculiar butler.

Title: 637. El nandaimeño
description: It is about the life of a peasant from the town of Nandaime who is in love with a girl, but the greatest local landowner wants to conquer her too and both must confront mischievously to win the fight they have imposed on each other. The boss - because he is rich and therefore powerful - has everything to gain, but the laborer will not let it be easy.

Title: 638. The Enemy General
description: An American OSS agent and the French underground attempt to rescue a Nazi general, who is awaiting execution by the Germans, and help him escape to London.

Title: 640. Das Erbe von Björndal
description: After all the drama in "Und Ewig Singen die Wälder", the surviving second son and heir, Dag junior, father of the next heir, lays his father in his grave. The former castle estate steward feared to be thrown out with his retarded son Lorenz, but is offered management again, and a new house for him and Adelheids's old aunt Eleonore Barre, the sister of Dag's now in-living father-in-law, Royal Guards Major Henrik a.D. Barre, who will tend to Bjorndal estate's bookkeeping. Dag is fair for his tenants, while hard for those who try to cheat him, and gives employ to hapless Gunvor, till her husband writes her sprung from jail, so she admits having been charged with the same murder as he; Dag finds and gets rid of her husband who tells him she was unfaithful with the victim, a rich apothecary in the city; paid off to leave for suggesting -perhaps truthfully- her baby is Henriks, showing the treasured ring the major once receives from a royal chamberlain, Gunvor takes revenge by breaking a window so his infant dies from the icy wind, while Adelheid worried what caused this nightly haste. After the funeral Eleonore convinces Adelheid happiness can only return after making up with Dag, and sends her brother to Dag, who warns him he can't continue taking the blame in his wife's eyes; the Major shoots himself, leaving a letter about his guilt. Years later the couple has other children; the wood business is good, exporting to Britain. Eleonore adopts orphan girl Barbara. When the flood causes logs to clog up in the river requiring an explosion, Lorenz takes Barabara for a coach drive and they jump in a boat; Dag jumps in at the last moment, but the logs catch up, only the girl gets safe ashore and becomes son Dag III's sweetheart...

Title: 642. Markado
description: Digno is an ordinary man with extraordinary strengths. He is known to his fellow townspeople as Markado the knight in shining Armour. However, his life turned upside down when Rilampago pretends to be Markado. Peace and order was eradicated as he portrays to be Markado so he can pursue his illegal acts. Witnessing the preconception and the dreadful effect of the make-believe Markado. Digno seeks vengeance to reinstate the peace and order in their town. Notwithstanding the battle he is into, a mystery is being unraveled as he gets closer to the bad guys.

Title: 643. Makkers, staakt uw wild geraas
description: The story of three torn apart families on the verge of Sinterklaasavond, the Dutch equivalent of Christmas Eve.

Title: 644. Erotika Paihnidia
description: A father is desperately trying to tame his young daughter, while she falls for a young man during their vacation In the island of Aegina, near Athens. But young love ignores fatherly threats and takes its course.

Title: 645. The Dam on the Yellow River
description: Anti-Communist propaganda flick, in which the victory of Mao Tse-Tung's People's Liberation Army is seen through the eyes of an American journalist reporting from the Nationalists'side.

Title: 646. Su primer amor
description: A young journalist organizes a song contest, which becomes a huge success, with the organizer himself winning the competition.

Title: 647. Un dollaro di fifa
description: Two conmen, Alamo and Mike, find shelter in Paradise City, which is full of jokers like themselves, who assume them to be lawmen and are almost hanged.

Title: 648. Appuntamento a Ischia
description: Letizia is a child, daughter of the singer Mimmo Rotunno, a widower, who does not look favorably on the marriage between his father and Mercedes, and is opposed in every way.

Title: 649. Mit 17 weint man nicht
description: Horst, the 18-year-old son of a factory owner, and 17-year-old Karin dream up their future together in the most beautiful colors. Newly married, however, they don't float on cloud nine as they had hoped, but sink into the dreary everyday life of marriage. While Horst ends his school career prematurely, Karin seeks help from her father-in-law.

Title: 650. Juanito
description: In the middle of a revolution, the son of a president ends up in the hands of a German hunter who welcomes him into his home, not knowing his origin.

Title: 651. Glocken läuten überall
description: The unscrupulous entrepreneur August Ehrlich is making his presence felt when he opens a cinema in a rural village.

Title: 652. Seven in the Sun
description: Two brothers are re-united when danger threatens in Argentina. Larry Anderson.

Title: 654. Das hab ich in Paris gelernt
655. El gran pillo
description: A taxi driver befriends the grandson of a rich businessman and falls in love with a lovely maid named María, a feisty but warmhearted young woman.

Title: 656. Love and Fashion
description: To make money for the aerial review, a group of students organize the fashion program for the "Yugochic" company, doing some small frauds as well.

Title: 657. The Touch of Flesh
description: Selfish and shameless rich teenage tramp Joan Denton gets impregnated by her earnest, yet dim-witted working class pushover boyfriend Eddie Mercer. Although Eddie wants to get married, Joan instead decides to convince her physician father Dr. Earl Denton to help her get an abortion. But things don't go exactly as Joan planned.

Title: 658. Blitz on Britain
description: Gives a detailed account of the Nazi blitz on Britain, which opened on May 10, 1940, and ended a year later with England bloody but unbowed and all Nazi hopes of invading the island rudely dashed.

Title: 661. I'm Dying for Money
description: A young factory worker loves his boss's daughter. He dreams of finding two bags of money, using the wealth to provide for his mother, save his boss from bankruptcy, and marry his beloved, only to suddenly wake up to reality.

Title: 662. Life Is a Circus
description: The employees of an ailing circus find Aladdin's magic lamp and decide to use it to save the organization.

Title: 663. Jungle Cat
description: This documentary chronicles the life of a female spotted jaguar in the South American jungle.

Title: 664. The Murderer Who Loved a Lot
description: A talented actor is imprisoned for the murder of a loathed theatre critic. His devoted girlfriend is convinced that her lover is innocent and asks a dear friend to help her clear his name.

Title: 667. Morte di un amico
description: Two young people trickle and steal and exploit prostitutes.

Title: 668. Genitori in blue-jeans
description: Some middle-aged Italian men try to have affairs with much-younger girls.

Title: 669. Trouble with Eve
description: In the quiet English village of Warlock, Louise Kingston turns her quaint cottage into a Tearoom. Louise hires the scandalous Daisy with the local inspector. Her daughter Eve provides further opportunities for double entendres.

Title: 671. Lal Quila
description: A fictional account of the real life struggle against the British East India Company. The First War of Independence from British influence in 1857 was a failure, resulting in the end of the Mughal Empire and later annexation of India in the name of Queen Victoria.

Title: 672. Venner
description: Two old friends climbing the Eagle Peak mountain, reveals an intelligent story about a friend trying to get rid of another and getting revenge, take the glory of friend's achievement, get his leading job in the firm, and even his woman.

Title: 675. Basant
description: A runaway spoiled rich girl is helped by a man she meets on the road, but their path to love is strewn with numerous misunderstandings, false accusations, a sudden tragedy and the pursing footsteps of a persistent pickpocket.

Title: 676. In the Nick
description: A gang of smalltime criminals is sent to an experimental prison where inmates are to be reformed, not punished. The leader of the gang plans to use this to his advantage and take control of the place through manipulation.

Title: 677. Questo amore ai confini del mondo
description: Argentinian-Italian western features a rancher and landowner who makes a common mistake - he marries the wrong woman, a dazzling showgirl.

Title: 678. Crésus
description: Jules is a shepherd who lives a humble and solitary life in rural Provence. From time to time, he is visited by a lonely widow, Fine, who longs to be his wife. One day, Jules comes across an unexploded bomb lying on the ground in open countryside.

Title: 679. Mi calle
description: Life events around a city street and its residents are told along the years while time goes by, wars break out and end and life evolves.

Title: 680. Snezhnaya skazka
description: New Year's Eve. The boy Mitya, who loves to fantasize, jokingly tells his comrades at school that his children's toy watch with painted hands is magical and can stop all the clocks in the world, stop time, or even revive a snowman.

Title: 682. Padikkatha Methai
description: Typical family melodrama of the 60s with Sivaji playing a simpleton devoted to the family that raised him. For once, Sivaji is overshadowed by SV Ranga Rao, who is unforgettable in the role of the head of the family. Great songs. Very emotional towards the end.

Title: 683. Gabi ng lagim
description: A vampire invaded the province. Arm of angry soul avenges those who killed him. A group of friends went to a house with a curse.

Title: 684. Operation Camel
description: As part of the U.N. patrol in Gaza, A group of Danish soldiers run into a series of misadventures.

Title: 685. My Dog, Buddy
description: A little boy loses his dog and his power of speech until a traumatic event brings them back together.

Title: 686. Fury of the Barbarians
description: At the end of the sixth century, a band of pagan savages attacks a peaceful northern province of Italy.

Title: 687. ¡Yo sabía demasiado!
description: A secretary is chased by two gangsters men to take away a recording that exposes her boss.

Title: 688. Le tre eccetera del colonnello
description: In Spain, during the Napoleonic rule, the French Governor of Andalusia is besieged by the locals who have countless demands and wishes.

Title: 689. Parvi urok
description: A lyrical account of a difficult love in a class-conscious society.

Title: 690. The Horse with the Flying Tail
description: A palomino pony, through a series of owners and adventures becomes a champion mount for one of the US equestrian teams.

Title: 691. Dokuritsu gurentai nishi-e
description: In this patriotic WW II drama, the Japanese army demonstrates its courage and willingness to do anything to win as they endeavor to sneak into Communist China to bring back the flag of a defeated enemy regiment.

Title: 693. Iguassu: The Devil's Throat
description: Four deserters from Paraguay War hide in an old drunkard's country seat. The latter has two daughters who are unhappy with their recluse lives.

Title: 694. Dead Lucky
description: Mike Billings decides to give gambling a go and it happens he's good at it. His instant fortune attracts quite a number of characters including a con artist, a hired killer, and the requisite attractive woman.

Title: 695. The Joker
description: Édourd Berlon lives care-freely, collecting lovers until he meets Hélène Laroche, a married woman. Despite their different worlds-his simplicity, her luxury-they run away together. Can their love survive their differences?

Title: 696. Ladrón que roba a ladrón
description: On-the-run outlaw Pardo and his sidekick Trompo, go into hiding in the small town of Arroyo Seco posing as a doctor and his assistant. Comic misadventures ensue.

Title: 697. Nie Er
description: Biography of famous Chinese composer Nie Er, who found the meaning of life by composing for national rejuvenation.

Title: 698. Les lionceaux
description: Patrice's good looks have made him a consummate womanizer but they also helped him win the heart of Juliette, the daughter of Blanche Eroli, an influential Parisian clothes designer. The latter doesn't want him as a husband for Juliette and would prefer to see her married to Vincent, her right hand man. To this end she offers Patrice a juicy check if he agrees to leave Juliette. He accepts the deal and leaves for the Riviera, where he discovers love in the person of pretty Caroline. But Juliette, who does not love Vincent, traces Patrice as far as Nice. Soon afterwards her dead body is found lying on her former fiancé's bed...

Title: 699. The Party Is Over
description: During the infamous decade, the grandson of a conservative leader of the Province of Buenos Aires will get into the affairs of his grandfather and discover a world of corruption.

Title: 700. Venganza Apache
description: A man selling rifles to Apaches starts an uprising.

Title: 701. Skandaali tyttökoulussa
description: The headmaster of a private girls' school, is doing her best to maintain strict discipline in the school. In addition to the loosening morals of the students, the warm relationship between two girls is a causing concern.

Title: 702. Mehlon Ke Khwab
description: Two girls round up a holiday after winning a lottery to find suitable husbands.

Title: 704. Gyvieji didvyriai
description: Four different stories about young kids' destinies in different time periods in Lithuania.

Title: 705. Ah, Love Is Beautiful
description: Antonio and Gertrudis call off their wedding after a fight. Their dispute becomes so extreme they decide to compete against each other for mayor.

Title: 707. Transatlantic
description: A gang of criminals steal jewels from a plane in mid-flight, after which they blow up the plane and escape by parachute. The pilot is suspected of involvement, but his sister tracks down the gang and clears her late brother's name.

Title: 708. Chaudhary Karnail Singh
description: In a village circa post British rule in India, a noble Sarpanch, Karnail Singh, is forced to chose sides between his son, Buta, and a Muslim couple, Shera and Naji, who want to get married amidst violent clashes between Hindus, Sikhs and Muslims before the formation of Pakistan; as well as deal with suspicious Indian Government officials.

Title: 709. Xing xing wang da zhan Huang Fei Hong
710. Prinsesa Naranja
description: 3 Romantic Stories in a great epic as colorful as it is magnificent.

Title: 711. When the Woman Butts In
description: Dr. Prucha, exhausted from work, attracts interest from women. A woman in red attends his lecture, prompting him to call her Mephistopheles. Later, she mysteriously appears in his room, leaving him questioning his sanity.

Title: 712. Bein edeik
description: Amal faces a difficult situation when her uncle demands that she get married .

Title: 713. People, Hopes, Medals
description: A documentary covering the 1960 Winter Olympic Games in Squaw Valley, California.

Title: 714. Tre önskningar
description: "Three Wishes". Oskar and Mona meet when they come to the Academy of Music to see if they have been accepted, he as a piano student, she a singing student. They become a couple and married but soon there are the frictions. Mona gets hundred crowns from her father, because he thinks she has become so charmless. For it, she buys a perfume called Three Wishes.

Title: 715. El ghagaria
description: Abu Doma kidnaps children and ransoms them back to their parents or sells them if the parents can't pay the ransom. During one of his operations, he returns the wrong girl to Hassan, who raises her with his adopted son Fathy. Salma, Hassan's real daughter, is raised by gypsies.

Title: 716. Izu Dancer
description: A love story about a young man on a holiday hiking in the Izu Peninsula, meeting with a dancing girl from a traveling family of entertainers.

Title: 719. Lovtsy gubok
description: The young man Nikolos is forced to engage in the fishing of sea sponges in order to get the hand of the beautiful Lenio. This work makes him a cripple, and marriage to his beloved does not bring happiness.

Title: 722. Gastone
description: During the period between world wars, vaudeville sketches were popular before film showings.Gastone is one of the characters played by the famous Ettore Petrolini who figures in these sketches.

Title: 723. Frihedens pris
description: Morten, a young sailor, returns home from a journey in the middle of the people's strike in 1944 and joins a resistance group.

Title: 724. Sømand i knibe
description: A Danish navy ship comes to port and the crew head for the same bar, most to get drunk, meet a woman and, with some luck, get into a fight.

Title: 725. Kurosen chitai
description: A reporter investigating a prostitution ring is framed for murder.

Title: 727. 13 Fighting Men
description: A Union Captain and his troops guard a load of gold from a group of Confederates at the end of the war

Title: 728. Revenge of the Barbarians
description: 408 AD. The Visigoths led by Alaric invade northern Italy. At Ravenna, they have to battle, and they are stopped by the power of the Roman legions and the cunning of the emperor's sister, Galla Placidia. As the Goths lose many warriors in the cruel battle, Alaric vows bloody revenge. When the Visigoths return to Ravenna, Galla Placidia manages to send them against Rome instead, and remains alone in her home city with a handful of soldiers. The Visigoths exert their revenge on Rome, attacked and sacked, but then Placidia is captured by Ataulf. The Roman Emperor of the West, Onorius, sends Olympius, consul of Rome, to negotiate Placidia's freedom. It comes down to a single duel between the courageous consul and Ataulf. Ataulf loses, and is honor bound to let Olympius free one of the women prisoners. The consul chooses Sabina, his lawful wife whom he had married for political reasons but for whom he had become in love. Galla Placidia, who longed for Olympius, is therefore forced to accept Ataulf for husband. Her gesture appeases the Visigoth's crave for revenge and the city of Ravenna is spared.

Title: 729. Le bois des amants
description: An impossible love between a French resistant fighter and a German officer's wife during WW2.

Title: 732. I baccanali di Tiberio
description: Cassio, a tourist guide, and Primo, his bus driver, are taking a bus load of tourists to visit Villa Jovis on Capri Island. Close to the Salto di Tiberio (Tiberius' Leap) they have an accident, and they knock their heads hard, losing consciousness. They wake up in Tiberius' villa, in the midst of an orgy, complete with a group of British dancers, mostly blondes, who are performing for the emperor. Soon, they are wise to an attempt on the emperor's life by his secretary, who plans to bring the blame on Cassio and Primo's heads. The two men dress up as dancers and try to mix with the British dancers who are led by Cinthia O'Connor. Meanwhile, the British dancers attack Flavinia, a co-conspirator, and a number of women she had planned to take the place of the dancers and shoot real arrows at the emperor during the dance. The two groups of women have a fight, and Cinthia and her girls prevail, stripping and arresting Flavinia and her seven girls. During the performance of the dance involving bows and arrows, the secretary stops the show and accuses the girls of plotting against the emperor's life. Cinthia surprises everybody by revealing she is, in fact, the daughter of Tiberius, and exposes the secretary as the conspirator. Everything is back to normal, and a large feast is organized; it is near the Salto di Tiberio and again, the two guides have a bad fall, knock their heads hard and become unconscious. They wake up at the place of their first fall. Everything must have been a dream. And yet, the first tourists they see are Tiberius and his daughter Cinthia.

Title: 733. Via Margutta
description: The lives, loves and disappointments of a group of artist friends living in the same neighborhood in Rome, Via Margutta, a mecca for young artists, each struggling to be a success.

Title: 735. The Sleeping Beast Within
description: A businessman returns from an extended trip, but something seems off. Criminal operations and religious cults come into play, while the man's daughter and her journalist boyfriend race to find the truth.

Title: 736. The Boy Who Stole a Million
description: A young lad working in a bank in Valencia 'borrows' a million pesetas so he can help his dad pay to get his taxi fixed. Instead he finds himself being chased all over town not only by the police but also by a selection of the local low-life after the cash.

Title: 737. For the Love of Mike
description: A young Indian boy trains a horse for an important race, hoping to win enough money to build a shrine for his village.

Title: 738. A Romantic Papa
description: A middle-aged man is laid off from work but is too proud to tell his family. His children, however, learn of the situation and take jobs of their own to help him save face.

Title: 739. La tijera de oro
description: Jealous barber Emilio tries stopping wealthy Mario from pursuing his girlfriend Rosita. Despite neighbors' financial help, a misunderstanding lands him in jail, but friends help resolve his troubles.

Title: 740. Knight of 100 Faces
description: Two knights, the honorful Riccardo and the sinister Fosco, are rivalling for damsel Zuela.

Title: 741. Monsieur Robinson Crusoe
description: A modern re-telling of the Robinson Crusoe story. But, this time, our hero is a macguivering expert. So he creates himself a modern paradise based on his beloved delivery tricycle that we saw in the previous movie, "The tricyclist".

Title: 742. Ayaz
description: Malik Ayaz, a general in the army of Sultan Mahmud of Ghazni: Ayaz (1960)was a landmark movie in 2 ways-its story was based on Muslim historical background, story of Mahmood Ghazanvi(971-1030A.D.)and his companion Ayaz (subject of this movie).Also this movie's film songs were super-hit due to the superb music of Khurshid Anwar.

Title: 743. Mud Mud Ke Na Dekh
description: Thakur Dayal Singh is a wealthy man and lives a very comfortable life with his wife, and daughter, Anita. He would like Anita to get married to his friend's son, but Anita refuses to agree to an arranged marriage, and would like to select her groom on her own. When Thakur disagrees, Anita runs away from home, and meets with a young man named Pritam Singh. After a series of misunderstandings, both are attracted to each other and fall in love. Anxious about his daughter's whereabouts, Thakur sends his men, and even offers to pay a reward for the safe return of his daughter. Anita is separated from Pritam, and taken back to her home, and marriage to a man she has never known before.

Title: 744. Code of Silence
description: An ex-mafioso moves to Mexico to become a writer, revealing mob secrets in his books which are met with understandable displeasure. He is soon pursued by hit-men as well as the FBI, who need his testimony in a court case.

Title: 745. Darbuján a Pandrhola
description:
Cuba Drobbyan (Jiri Sovak) is a poor cavalier who has a good wife (Bela Jurdova) and eleven children. When it comes to the twelfth, Cuba decides to go into the world and get a good godfather for him. Meanwhile, the old man meets Bohas Zahorsky, but he does not want to be a godfather, because he is not equally equitable to all people, he rejects the devil (Otakar Brousek), eventually meets the Deathwalker (Vaclav Lohnisky) whom he chooses because he belongs to all people just equitable. The Deathwoman makes a treaty with Cuba and gives him a special gift: When Cuba sees him with a sick person at his head, the person dies if he stands at his feet, the healer heals. Cuba tries it a few times, and the Death Gift works. Cuba will gradually become a respected and popular folk healer.

The rich and fat brewery brewer Pandrhola (Rudolf Hrusinsky), who has always refused to help and make fun of Kuba and all the local poor miners, is the counterpart of the poor cavalier. Even one day it will get sick. He calls Cuba, but he first refuses because Deathwoman stands in the bed's heads. In the end, however, Cuba is allowed to cope with Pandhra and treats it despite the fact that it breaks the deal with the Death Eater - let the bed with Pandrhola turn around so that the Deathwoman, standing at the head, stands at his feet. But Pandrhola lets Smrtak be trapped in a brewery barrel, making it impossible for anything alive to die. This will cause great confusion and upheaval on the ground. Eventually, Death Knight comes out of the barrel, Pandrhol sets off with his deadly scythe, and Kuba definitively removes his gift.

Title: 746. The Underdog
description: Blessed, or cursed, with the gift of beauty, an orphaned woman enlists the help of a handsome shipowner to send her off to Australia. Smitten by her, he does everything in his power to be with her; but, will he let her leave Greece?

Title: 747. Touchez pas aux blondes
description: The bodies of two young women have been found. They both wear the same snake tattooed on their arm. Lieutenant Al Wheeler - interpreted by the French actor and singer Philippe Clay - is following the trail of a criminal organisation that manages a network of young prostitutes. The trail leads him to a strange mix of respectable business men and despicable criminals and a lot of beautiful girls. A womaniser with a strong sense of humour, Al Wheeler is also an astute policeman who doesn't neglect any detail. A lively French comedy inspired by an American novel, an American noir viewed through a typical French film director.

Title: 751. Ôsen chitai
description: A criminal drama told in a semi-documentary fashion. The murder of the chief official of Kobe city's Customs triggers an investigation of a prostitution ring called the 'Yellow Line' that sells Japanese women.

Title: 752. It Happened All Night
description: Michel Ferréol reluctantly meets up with an old school friend, Antoine Fiesco. Michel didn't like Antoine much when they were at school and tries to get away by making an excuse. He changes his mind when Antoine introduces him to his wife, a beautiful brunette named Christine.

Title: 754. El pequeño coronel
description: Joselito, the only son of a Spanish noble gone to the Americas, lives peacefully with his servants and tutors in his estate near Seville. But when he ends up under the care of his ambitious and ruthless uncle, he might have to fight to survive.

Title: 756. Kalb fi zalam
description: A girl seeks happiness by marrying a rich man, leaving her poor lover. She later discovers he works for her husband and tries to win back his love.

Title: 757. På en bänk i en park
description: Sam Persson is released from a mental hospital. He goes to Stockholm to meet a man he hates, theater manager Stig Brender. In Brender's office they get into a fight and Persson falls down dead. Brender uses his car to get rid of the body in a park. However, the following day he is visited by police inspector Envall, who wants to talk to him. Brender's lies and strange behavior is no match for some thorough police work.

Title: 758. It Was I Who Drew the Little Man
description: On September, 1. In school the first-ever came boy Fedya. In the ardor of gladness Fedya drew coal on the white wall of little merry man in a hat and with an umbrella.

Title: 759. L'homme à femmes
description: Sentimental events of a rich industrialist which turn to the criminal case.

Title: 760. La cárcel de Cananea
description: La Carcel de Cananea is a Mexican western starring the popular Pedro Armendariz as a lawman on the scent of a young criminal.

Title: 761. I piaceri del sabato notte
description: Behind the facade of a fashionable Milanese home, headed by Arabella, lies an efficient ring of high prostitution.

Title: 762. Tomorrow Is Bright
description: Discovering her husband has fallen under the influence of a cabaret singer, a devoted wife drastically transforms her appearance and behavior to win him back. After a series of adventures, she successfully reunites their family.

Title: 763. La procesión
description: People of different classes meet on a pilgrimage to the Basilica of Our Lady of Luján.

Title: 764. Signori si nasce
description: Baron Zazà, always broke due his dissolute lifestyle, decides to con a hefty sum of money out of his wealthy but greedy brother.

Title: 765. A False Student
description: After failing the entrance exam for university for the fourth time, a young man pretends to be a student to avoid the shame of his family.

Title: 766. Shriman Satyawadi
description: An orphan refuses to lie to further his and others' careers.

Title: 767. The Young Jacobites
description: Two children on holiday on The Isle of Skye, Scotland, go back in time and help Bonnie Prince Charlie escape from Scotland to France.

Title: 769. Verano violento
description: During the Mexican Revolution, Beatriz's body is discovered by some kids. The police began to investigate the history of Beatriz.

Title: 771. Taiheiyô Sensô: Nazo no senkan Mutsu
772. La main chaude
description: A widow in her fifties,Madame Lacoste ,meets Jean when they both come to put their pussy in a cattery.The man borrows a hefty sum from her ,to send his sick young son to breathe the fresh air of the country ,or so he said.

Title: 775. Chafalonías
description: A simple and good-natured man finds out after the death of his wife that she was cheating on him.

Title: 776. Qi xi
description: Fang lead a squad to explode the Kangping bridge.

Title: 777. Guards on the Railway Line
description: In the center of the film is the story of a conspiracy uncovered by state security workers with the help of railroad workers.

Title: 780. Piccadilly Third Stop
description: In London, a bogus playboy, a debt-ridden American, a small-time thief and a retired safecracker team up to rob a foreign embassy's safe by digging a tunnel from the London Underground into the embassy's cellar.

Title: 781. A Bully in 1900
description: The moral conflicts of a conservative politician, his wife and a bully, in the Buenos Aires of the early twentieth century.

Title: 782. Flemming og Kvik
description: Following two best friends in school and how their principal tries to help them through their many problems.

Title: 783. Sarhad
description: Four people embroiled in complicated relationships look for closure.

Title: 785. Köyde Bir Kiz Sevdim
description: The story of three men doing dirty work to get the farm they work.

Title: 786. Hristina
description: Passionate about crime novels, a waiter and his charming sister, Christina, are bent on uncovering the elusive Fantômas of Thessaloniki, hot on the trail of her boss' enigmatic son. Are the intrepid amateur detectives onto something?

Title: 787. The Dreams Came by Coach
description: Comedy concerning an impostor who comes into a little town and turns everything upside down. Based on three comedies by Jovan Sterija Popovic.

Title: 788. Gustav Adolfs Page
description: Gustl Leubelfing, daughter of the mayor of Nuremberg adores the king of the Swedes. So she happily substitutes for her brother as Gustav Adolf's page instead of marrying her fiancé Roland. Of course she must hide that she's a woman, especially when they go to war against Wallenstein.

Title: 789. Si le vent te fait peur
790. Rockets in the Dunes
description: Kids who race sand yachts face losing their Devon beach to Army training. They seek community help but need money for a meeting hall rental. Old war mines found in dunes add complications.

Title: 791. Sábado a la noche, cine
description: The attitudes of different people before going to the movies.

Title: 792. Chudotvornaya
description: Rodka Gulyaev is a pupil of the Gumniskii rural secondary school. He on the bank of the river and digs up a darkened old icon. His grandmother Avdotya, an overbearing and cunning old woman, starts a rumor that the icon is miraculous, and her granddaughter is a saint. This event radically changed the life of the youngster, since the villagers called him "the chosen one of God." Rodka was forced to pray and intimidate with "punishments of God," leading the pioneer to attempt suicide.

Title: 793. La brune que voilà
description: Germain Vignon is a used car dealer whose eloquence is such that he could sell the lousiest banger to a guy that does not even have a driver's license. He is not bad either at chatting up girls. Indeed, since his blonde wife left him, Germain has seduced no fewer than four brunettes. And as, besides being a ladies'man, he has a heart of gold, Germain is unable to break up with any of them, hence a complicated sentimental life. But this delicate balance is threatened the day an outraged stranger comes to him and orders him to leave his wife alone. One small problem is that the man has forgotten to specify the name of the lady in question. So, which of his four mistresses - Christine, Sophie, Anne-Marie or Sonia - should he leave?

Title: 794. Chien de pique
description: After an adventurous life, Patrick settled in the Camargue and bought a ranch where he raised bulls, while the "rice fields" gradually invade and transform the country.

Title: 796. The Doll Behind the Curtain
description: Majid finds out that his father (Nosrat) is unfaithful to his mother (Mehri). He plans to stop Nosrat's affairs.

Title: 799. Das schwarze Schaf
description: Father Brown tries to solve some murders.

Title: 801. Recours en grâce
description: Mario di Donati, a deserter from the Italian army, lives in Paris under a false name with Germaine, his French lover. When the latter learns about his hidden past, she feels hurt by Mario's lack of trust in her and she distances herself from him. In despair, Mario surrenders to the law but, at the time of trial, he runs away to join the woman he loves...

Title: 802. Trizhdy voskresshiy
description: A story of one ship, which fate is bound with a tragic history of Russia in the 20th century.

Title: 803. Kriminaltango
description: The owner of an mighty villa ran out of money. He was a host to his friends, but they didn't pay the rent. He is instructing his housekeeper Lorenz to sell it. He meanwhile, is visiting his aunt in the countryside. Lorenz complains, cause he has taken his money and the money of his uncle before, so he is able to pay the bills! But no way! No interest. He leaves! When resting with the aunt He ready in newspapers there ist an announce fromm a girl watching out for a Job. At his adress! He immediately jumps into the car, finding out what happened this time!

Title: 804. Tis mias drahmis, ta giasemia
description: A car accident leads Alexis, a young businessman, to fall in love with Anna-Maria, a poor student at the Athens Conservatory and the granddaughter of a former conductor. But can Alexis be trusted?

Title: 806. Liebling der Götter
description: Biography of the famous German actress Renate Mueller, who died in 1937 under unsettled circumstances; While doing her first movie for the UFA in Berlin, she meets the elderly secretary-general Dr. Simon and is impressed by his charm. Although her Nazi-friend Volker discourages her to befriend a Jew, they start dating. While she ascends to one of the most famous German actresses of her time, Simon is suffering more and more under the Nazi regime.

Title: 807. X-25 Reports
description: Resistance member is sent to infiltrate Nazi intelligence during WW2.

Title: 808. Alfonso XII y María Cristina: ¿Dónde vas triste de ti?
description: Following Queen Mercedes' death, King Alfonso XII must choose a new wife to secure Spain's succession. He selects Maria Christina of Habsburg, but memories of his first love cast a shadow over their royal union.

Title: 811. Nyhtes sto Miramare
description: The lovely sisters of a wealthy Arab aristocrat visit the picturesque island of Rhodes, Greece, to spend their summer vacation incognito. There, they find themselves in a romantic affair with two charming strangers.

Title: 813. O Viúvo Alegre
description: It tells the story of Danilo, who becomes a widower on Countess Pompéia's wedding night.

Title: 814. Madri pericolose
description: A great Party is given by the rich family of Improta. Every kind of intrigue gets around this party. The purpose of every plan is to find a husband or a wife with a quality: wealth. The counts Ornano have invested all they had in Maura, hoping in a good marriage. Mattea gets a fake invitation for her daughter Regina. Nicky Improta has prepared a really great surprise for her mother. Massimo falls in love with Maura Ornano who, according to the family plan, should marry Enrico. The cards are shuffled.

Title: 815. Kahpe
description: The married Belkis comes to visit Bülent one hot night. She tells him the heat makes people greedy and promiscuous.

Title: 816. The Greeneyed Elephant
description: Two aspiring actresses stumble upon an ancient Aztec elephant sculpture that through the action of their best friend can be used to transfer their body into the other.

Title: 817. Duniya Jhukti Hai
description: After getting ditched by his love interest Laxmi, Mohan turns into criminal and known as Bankelal. But he meets Laxmi's son and befriends with him.

Title: 819. Le gigolo
description: A wealthy widow in her forties wants to end a relationship with her younger lover, who isn't ready to let go.

Title: 820. Makrykostaioi kai Kondogiorgides
description: An 80 year old vendetta finally lands on the hands of two peace loving, and not so brave men, who both fear each others intent.!

Title: 821. Prezil jsem svou smrt
description: A Czech boxer is imprisoned inside a German concentration camp during World War II.

Title: 822. The Royal Ballet
description: Filmed on the stage of London's Covent Garden. Includes extracts from Swan lake, Ondine & The Firebird.

Title: 823. Bewaqoof
description: In his quest for a heir, Rai Bahadur has an affair with a prostitute Meher. When Meher becomes pregnant he promises to take the child and educate him. But fate has other plans, for his wife Meena also becomes pregnant at the same time, and shortly thereafter both women give birth to two boys. Meher threatens to expose him if he does not take her son, and leave Meena's son in an orphanage. However, both children end up in his palatial home. He belittles Meher's son and finally accuses him of stealing. Fed up of these accusations, Meena leaves the house with Kishore, and ironically ends up with Meher. In the meantime, Rai's son has grown up to be an arrogant, and a champion boxer. And it is in the boxing ring that both half-brothers will meet again -- for a match of their lives -- as the trophy is none other than the beautiful Mala -- who both love and hope to marry.

Title: 827. To hamini
description: When a feisty gamine and a charming nobleman fall in love, they must brave bitter family confrontations and social prejudice to take control of their lives before class divides tear the two devoted soulmates apart.

Title: 828. Gitarren klingen leise durch die Nacht
description: Austrian singer-writer Fred Wiskott is a hit in Viennese showbiz, and enjoyed countless affairs. Just when he's finally ready to commit to one girl, chosen show dancer Ninon Lorraine commits a suicide attempt. Fred goes on holiday to the Sicilian fishery port of Taormina with his friend, painter Paulchen 'Paolo' Sperling. Fred immediately takes to local rascal Roberto, who cares nothing for girls, except his big sister Marina. But she considers Fred her way out into the big world. She manages to seduce him, which messes up her vocal trio with Salvatore and local admirer Jacopo, while Paul convinced Nannon to visit and get him back.

Title: 830. Ali and the Camel
description: Story of a boy and his "guardian angel," who just happens to be a talking camel. The magical beast will help the young Arab track down jewels stolen during a robbery.

Title: 831. Zameen Ke Tare
description: A rich child and a poor one are both unhappy and search for God in the Himalayas.

Title: 832. Pierrot la tendresse
description: An old gentleman who loves his tender garden and pupil turns out to be an old killer.

Title: 833. Gaudí
description: The life and tragic death of the architect who revolutionized the artistic world with his works, such as La Sagrada Familia in Barcelona.

Title: 835. Matandang Pa-Charming
description: Who would imagine that gays can be harsh? This film featured a gang composed of gays who was notorious for their illegal works in some popular parks and clubs in Manila. Carding (Leopoldo Salcedo) and Tomas (Ramon Revilla) were tasked to look after this gang by their Chief (Investigation Agency) and the two were asked to dress-up and disguise as real gays. They have to learn a lot of gay stuff and many people misunderstood them. Their glamour and fake charm might be funny and a cause of headache but a key to solve a certain case.

Title: 836. Fighting Delinquents
description: Sadao and his orphaned buddies attempt to prevent his aged grandmother from being shaken down by a gangster, his goons, and his lawyers.

Title: 837. Domaren
description: Krister and his fiancé Brita return to Stockholm after a stay in Italy. Shortly upon their return Krister learns that all his assets left to him by his father has disappeared. Together with Brita he tries to obtain justice in an aristocratic and corrupt legal system.

Title: 838. Lovers on a Tightrope
description: Cora, the wife of a wealthy Parisian businessman, Daniel, is involved in an affair with Henri, an unscrupulous garage mechanic who has set his sights on Cora's fortune. Daniel becomes suspicious and hires a detective to investigate, but the detective is unsuccessful in pinpointing Cora's extramarital activities.

Title: 840. A Viúva Valentina
description: Valentina, a poor, widowed seamstress, inherits shares in a company considered bankrupt.

Title: 841. Brücke des Schicksals
description: An ambitious photo-journalist creates his own stories to get sensational scoops.

Title: 844. La llamada de la muerte
description: Bank-robber hiding out after a heist discovers that half the world knows where he is. Can he finesse some way out of his predicament?

Title: 845. Over gaden - Neden vandet
description: Lejla is the foster child of a grumpy and dried-up old man and his bold, vivacious wife. The girl is raped by a sailor, then befriends a very different man - an intellectual illustrator and artist of life. He tries in vain to transform Lejla into his ideal image of a so-called 100 percent woman. In order to develop her life and become herself, Lejla leaves him for a disabled young man she has met by chance and has grown to like. Inspired by French film's new wave.

Title: 847. Tavriya
description: Sofía Falzfein owns a prosperous grain business, complete with its own distribution port. Anna, of humble origin, is ambitious and will try to seduce the Falzfeins' son, but his mother will cast her out. Soon, the revolution will erupt.

Title: 848. Todo el año es Navidad
description: Santa Claus assumes the guise of a worker, a maid, a clerk and a bartender to solve the problems of different people.

Title: 850. Akharin havas
description: A young man who is the bully in the neighborhood and many girls had fall for him before is fall in love himself.

Title: 853. Spring Dreams
description: A homeless man falls ill near a wealthy family's home, who take him in and find themselves dealing with his visiting friends.

Title: 854. Podnyataya tselina
description: Historical drama, based on the novel by Mikhail Sholokhov. It depicts the events in Cossack region on Dov river in early 1930s.

Title: 855. Barefoot Adventure
description: Exploration of the thrilling world of surfing, capturing breathtaking rides and coastal scenery from iconic wave destinations.

Title: 856. Onna shikeishû no datsugoku
description: Rich industrialist Imai wishes to marry his elder daughter Kyoko off to Aoki, who he sees as the ideal candidate to take over his business. Kyoko, however, prefers the rugged but poor Soichi to Aoki's goody-two-shoes.

Title: 857. Treis koukles ki ego!
description: As the lithe accountant of an haute couture house on the brink of bankruptcy takes three beautiful mannequins to promote their work, a chance encounter with a rich businessman will soon pave the way for a delightful romance under the sun.

Title: 858. Drug predsednik centarfor
description: Through several entangled stories, province atmosphere is shown, in which new ideas are hard to penetrate. Parallel with the seventh anniversary of peasant's cooperative farm, activity of a priest, who wants to restore the iconostases, is followed. Local photographer intrigues - in small town in which the villagers want to become football champions.

Title: 859. Anne Bäbi Jowäger - I. Teil: Wie Jakobli zu einer Frau kommt
description: The trials of the wealthy Emmentaler farming family Jowäger, adapted from the 19th century novel of the same name by Jeremias Gotthelf (pen-name of Albert Bitzius), which was also published in two parts.

Title: 861. Lunatycy
description: A group of hooligans in the amusement park injures a passerby. One of the attackers is taken by the journalist as a defender of the attacked.

Title: 862. Tsakitzis: Protector of the Poor
description: Having sworn to protect the poor in the far-off territories of early-1900s Anatolia, Tsakitzis and his men thwart the ruthless Pasha's plans. However, the evil ruler has an unexpected ally. Can love defeat the legendary hero's sharp sword?

Title: 864. La Garçonniere
description: A building constructor repeatedly betrays his wife in an apartment he rented in a popular neighborhood. She finds out and the couple will never be the same again.

Title: 865. Szklana góra
description: In the provincial Silesian town of Szklana Góra (Glass Mountain), the arrival of young doctor Beata for her compulsory hospital internship arouses feelings in Anastazy - an uneducated, young worker from the local quarries. The differences in intellectual level and the pressure of small-town prejudices make him reflect on his future life and inspire higher aspirations in him. When an accident occurs in the quarries, and Anastazy is among the injured, it turns out that Beata is not indifferent to him either. However, the differences in outlook on life and the lack of decisiveness on the part of both of them ultimately result in the fact that after completing the practice, the girl surreptitiously leaves for the capital.

Title: 868. Plousioi horis lefta
description: An honest man hands over a bag full of money to its owner despite his great financial need.

Title: 870. Luciano Romero
description: Jilted boyfriend goes gunning for his ex's new husband, kills her by accident. Husband takes it badly. Sequel to El Hombre Del Alazan (1959).

Title: 871. Les Tonnes de l'Audace - Mission Ténéré Tchad
description: Documentary on African expedition between Algeria and Chad in 1959-60.

Title: 873. Juan Tamad Goes to Society
description: Lazy Juan (Manuel Conde) is very bold in his statement about politics and governance in the country. Garbed in a colorful, intricately-designed outfit (designed by Carlos "Botong" Francisco) with various political placards in the background, Juan Tamad looks clueless in the middle of the chaos. The cleverly-conceptualized cover practically summarizes the story of 'Juan Tamad Goes to Congress' where Juan Tamad, egged on by his creditors who imagined that the only way Juan can pay off his debts is to be elected to Congress and is given the usual bribe money that goes along with the position, campaigns, and eventually gets elected to Congress.

Title: 874. Meurtre en 45 tours
description: (1961) Danielle Darrieux, Michael Auclair. A singer believes she's being haunted by the ghost of her dead husband.

Title: 875. Os dois Ladrões
description: The sophisticated thief Mão Leve and his simple-minded accomplice Jonjoca take from the rich to give to the poor. Their new mission is raising funds in order Mão Leve's brother can study abroad. But great care must be taken lest the honest boy discovers the origin of the money.

Title: 876. Un couple
description: After testing their love,Pierre and Anne decide to leave each other.

Title: 877. Silvesterpunsch
description: After their successful May party, now the Lehmann family want to throw a New Year's Eve part with punch. Wilhelm's sons Franz and Paul are brigade leaders at a chemical factory. One of their brigades consists largely of fanatics of high culture, while the other consists of sports fanatics. But the rival brigades must work together in order to throw a successful New Year's Eve party for the factory, since the occasion requires both elements: sports and culture. There is an ice show in the program, the star of which is Wilhelm's granddaughter Suse. Knispel from the sports-inclined brigade follows Paul's rigorous training plan for her and stubbornly refuses to let matters of the heart get in the way. Knispel, along with the pretty Ruth, still succeed at convincing the iron athlete Paul of the utility of culture and the collaboration between the two areas. The athletically and artistically brilliant ice show is a big hit.

Title: 878. La hermana blanca
description: In the 19th century, a young woman enters a convent when her father dies and her suitor is Missing in Action, but when he returns unharmed from war she believes that she can only choose between God and her man until a third possibility emerges.

Title: 879. La 1000eme fenêtre
description: An old man against the public housing project.

Title: 881. Juke Box Racket
description: Mario ('Peter Clune'), a gangster, takes the fifth amendment when being questioned by the Senate Sub Committee on his connection with racketeering within the juke box industry. While in a small New Jersey town, teenagers Bob (Steve Karmen), Judy (Arlene Corwin),Ginger (Beverly Nazarow), Seymour (Seymour Cassel) and Betty ('Dalene Young (II)' go to the train station to pick up Judy's cousin-from-Tennessee, Lulubelle (Lou Anne Lee). They take her to their local hangout, a pizzeria called "Mom & Pops", a broken down place ran by a couple named Mom (Emy Boselli) and Pop (William J. Daprato.) After leaving the senate hearing, Mario, on his way to a large meeting of racketeers, drops by the pizzeria for a cold drink, and notices that Pop's jukebox is not one belonging to the syndicate. He asks the local rep of the syndicate, Morty Belowsky (Ray Singer to find out why, and Morty reports the place doesn't make enough money to make it worthwhile, but Mario isn't having any of that and orders the syndicate's box be put in "for the principle of the thing."

Title: 882. La rana verde
description: In Cimera de los Infantes, a peaceful and imaginary Castilian town, the youngsters are bored because they hardly have fun to vent the ardor of their youth. That's why they meet every day in a bar called The green frog, where, between games of dominoes, they plan to seduce girls from wealthy families who stay during the summer in a residence located in the town's castle.

Title: 890. True Confessions
description: Four Stories, Four Directors.

Title: 891. Many Ways to Sin
description: At the Griffith Theatre, magician Dante is about to return to the stage to take another bow when he is overcome by dizziness and later professes that he finds it difficult to distinguish between reality and illusion. That night, Dantes assistant for his guillotine act, Velma, quits and warns stage manager Gwendolyn Spears, who is secretly in love with Dante, that the magician is dangerously insane. In the lobby, while playboy and singer Beau Joe impatiently waits for Velma, with whom he has date, he jokes with theater owner Griffith that he wishes the guillotine would chop Velmas head off. The next day, after the newspapers report that Velmas decapitated body has been found, Inspector Evans interrogates members of the cast and crew. Joe admits to his conversation with Griffith and Gwen acknowledges that she fought with Velma over her quitting. Mama Rose tells the inspector that Joe once threatened her with a knife and that she believes he is the murderer. When questioned, Dante suddenly states that Velma had to go and collapses from one of his spells. Later, when Evans asks for an alibi, Dantes devoted assistant Carter claims that he and Dante were playing chess. That night, Dantes new assistant, Elinor Benson, tells her roommate Sharon that she is quitting because she fears Dante. After Elinor is discovered burned to death in her room, Evans arrests Sharon for the crime, but explains to Lt. Hennessey that the arrest is just a misdirection to bring out the real murderer. In the middle of the next guillotine act, Gwen, who has taken the victim role, suddenly realizes that when his assistants begin to fear them, Dante confirms their fear by killing them. As she screams for Evans help, Carter calls out maestro, maestro.

Title: 892. Morals Squad
description: A NYC vice-squad detective has traced the headquarters of the city's largest vice-ring to a lower east-side bar catering to businessmen to want to entertain their out-of-town clients properly by supplying them with call-girls. He is known by the madam, so he assigns a detective to infiltrate the gang and get the necessary evidence for prosecution. The undercover cop is recognized by one of the prostitutes as he had once picked her up on a shoplifting charge. Detective O'Connell then assigns a policewoman to get a job as one of the ring's call-girls.

Title: 893. Talat rijal wa emraa
description: Samya a girl on the search for her white knight. First, she falls for the anchor Ahmed but after he proposes, she finds herself falling for the athlete Mokhtar. Then she falls for Dr. Galal, only to find herself unable to choose between the three of them.

Title: 894. Probuzení
description: Jitka, an untrained 16-year-old hairdresser, runs away from the youth home and returns to a group of hooligans led by a young man named Vilda. They all hang out in Prague's arcades and make their money by petty theft and fraud. One day Jitka takes a liking to Tonek, a waiter's apprentice. The girl returns his feelings, but at the same time she doesn't want to drag him down. But her cronies have no scruples. And so Tonek becomes a member of their gang.

Title: 895. Bahia de Todos os Santos
description: Salvador, Bahia, Brazil, during the dictatorship of Getúlio Vargas. Outlaw Tonio is involved in a conflict between strikers and the police. His mistress tries to keep him from his companions, but he steals her belongings to help the persecuted. Dissatisfied, she denounces him, compromising him politically.

Title: 896. Pintando o Sete
description: Catito, a clown, manages to flee a forced marriage, by hiding inside Dr. Cláudio's car trunk. In Rio de Janeiro, his host forces him to impersonate the famous painter Picanssô, to impress his girlfriend Sílvia's friends. She's a socialite whose main interest is her own social projection.

Title: 898. Bessonnaya noch
description: Typical Soviet "industrial drama" (or "production drama"). The handsome hero is a young man out of college, assigned to his first important engineering job in far-off Sibirsk. The hero tries to cope with serious industrial problems (some caused by his own carelessness), and in one case his old crane operator is seriously injured in a crane accident. At the same time the hero faces a romantic dilemma. He is torn between two loves, his current fiancée and his old flame, who shows up unexpectedly, still hoping to win him back. Many problems, many conflicts, subjecting the hero to a "sleepless night." Will he manage to resolve all his dilemmas?

Title: 899. Die zornigen jungen Männer
description: Hamburg 1960. Three very different, 30-something men in the evolving Federal Republic meet and their destinies interweave with each other; Advertising manager Fred Plötz, his friend, lawyer, Dr. Jürgen Faber and obsessed physician Dr. Gerd Schneider.

Title: 901. Eventyrrejsen
description: There are high expectations in the air when a group of strangers gather to travel to some of Europe's cultural capitals. Included in the trip is a wide section of the population - young and old, rich and less rich, quirky and sympathetic. Common to them all is that they are embarking on an adventure journey that they will soon forget.

Title: 902. Uta andon
description: Remake of Naruse Mikio's 1943 film "The Song Lantern.

Title: 905. Nebuchadnezzar
description: The story of king Nebuchadnezzar II who ruled Babylon 605 BC.

Title: 910. Kung ako'y mahal mo
description: Now they are happy in each other's arms--but how long will it be before the past catches up with them?

Title: 911. Just Joe
description: Joe (Leslie Randall) a bumbling clerk in a detergent factory becomes involved in a plot to steal the firm's latest formula.

Title: 912. Mendi Rang Lagyo
description: Watch the full movie, Mehndi Rang Lagyo, only on Eros Now. Mehndi Rang Lagyo a 2002 Indian Gujarati film, directed by Subhash. J. Shah and produced by Ashok Patel. The film stars Naresh Kanodia, Roma Manek, Shalini, Arvind Rathod, Ramesh Mehta, Arvind Joshi, Devendra Pandit in lead roles. The film had musical score by Mahesh-Naresh.

Title: 914. Mirage
description: A young man comes to Stockholm City and experiences several bizarre situations.

Title: 916. Zorikan the Barbarian
description: Zorikan the Exterminator (1964). A warrior of the Crusades helps in the Christians' fight against Islamic invaders.

Title: 917. Elsewhere the Cackling
description: The revolution of an oppressed husband, whose wife locked him in the coop.

Title: 919. The Wild Animal
description: A poor girl is fired from her job because of a rich lady. He finds her savior in this woman's suitor, but without knowing the relationship between them.

Title: 920. Thaimí, la hija del pescador
description: Thaimí, a beautiful and talented fisherman's daughter, becomes a celebrated night club singer as she is torn by the love of two men who happen to be brothers.

Title: 921. Dormitorio para señoritas
description: A case of mistaken identity lands a lawyer at an all-girls boarding school, where he must keep up appearances as their new music professor.

Title: 923. Melodías de hoy
description: A female singer participating in a festival of modern music hired as a driver a guy who turns out to be another singer who also participates in the same festival. Love affairs, mistakes and a robbery will commit in the same hotel where both were staying.

Title: 924. Koga no misshi
description: Corruption threatens the Mizorogi clan as dying lord's heir, Young Lord Masayasu, is imprisoned. His fiancée, Princess Mari, searches for him, while ninjas Ryunosuke and Oyuki battle corrupt officials to restore the clan.

Title: 929. 6 Nam Mae
description: Based on the novel by Han Sorya. About children who lost their parents as a result of the Korean War.

Title: 930. Entre Dios y el hombre
description: A concert pianist gets caught in a love triangle with two college students.

Title: 936. Noose for a Gunman
description: Case Britton, gunslinger and wanted man, comes to town to meet his bride-to-be, stop a stagecoach robbery, and get even with the man who killed his brother.

Title: 937. I zavoliara
description: A fisherman's daughter is secretly in love with a strong man who works for her father; however, after a nearly-fatal accident, the crew will have to venture into the isle's notoriously dangerous waters. Will they return in one piece?

Title: 938. Koroghlu
description: Legendary hero Koroghlu leads a rebellion against foreign invaders and local oppressors. With his loyal companions and his beloved Nigar beside him, he fights for justice, freedom and the oppressed people of Azerbaijan.

Title: 940. Der Herr mit der schwarzen Melone
description: Hugo Wiederkehr, as a dutiful bank employee, has to deal with all kinds of customers. Among other things, with the industrialist Meissen and his pretty daughter Christine, with whom he falls in love.

Title: 942. La quiniela
description: Don Cándido Palomo is an old office worker and owner of a modest guest house who, without having any idea of football, fills his first pool at the request of a coworker named Olmedilla. The problem will come when, infected by the hobby of constantly checking the results of the matches, don Cándido drags his entire family along in his obsession with becoming a millionaire.

Title: 943. The Boy I Love
description: Bent on conquering his heart, a crafty high-school student barges into the life of a debonair and handsome young actor. However, it will take two long years before he notices his persistent and beautiful fan. Do dreams come true?

Title: 944. Virou Bagunça
description: Three singers, who call themselves "Trio Gerimum", arrive in Rio de Janeiro trying to succeed in their artistic career. They struggle with great difficulties and even sing on the streets. Chased by the police, they accidentally end up in a television studio, where they are mistaken for northeastern deputies. Settled the misunderstanding, they are hired by a TV commercial star to fake her kidnapping to promote her theatrical debut. Confusion escalates with the arrival of a crazy general, a group of bearded revolutionaries and an outlaw.

Title: 945. Man Against Man
description: Kikumori runs a cabaret on the docks, while his friend Kaji operates transport boats. When a gang of drug dealers tries to force the pair to cooperate in a smuggling scheme, conflict arises between the two friends. Falsely blamed for murder, Kikumori is blackmailed into an attempt to sabotage Kaji's boats and kill him. But the friendship between the two men proves an obstacle to the gangleader's plans.

Title: 947. Sen-hime goten
description: The men who approach Princess Sen, secluded in her palace, die one after the other, their bodies found lying in a nearby swamp. A costume love story, tinged with the supernatural.

Title: 951. Was wäre, wenn...?
description: When an East German village is relocated fantasy style to the West, the residents become greedy adjusting to a different economic system and worried whether the cooperative farms they have been used to under Socialism will return.

Title: 954. Podnyataya tselina - vtoraya seriya
description: Historical drama, based on the novel by Mikhail Sholokhov. It depicts the events in Cossack region on Dov river in early 1930s.

Title: 959. Huwag mo akong limutin
description: EXPLOSIVE - THE WHOLE TOWN IS TALKING ABOYT IT.

Title: 965. Four Religions
description: Underscoring a basic unity of the four major world religions (Hinduism, Buddhism, Islam and Christianity), this National Film Board of Canada project deems each a "higher" religion, "something that inspires man to love, to seek the meaning and the purpose of life." Interspersed with a stimulating discussion between the host, filmmaker, series producer and National Film Board co-founder James Beveridge and the great historian Arnold Toynbee, the film touches on the commonalities and distinctions between (as well as the enduring significance of) these world religions, emphasizing, as Toynbee says, that whatever one's own religious beliefs, "each of us, for his own personal life, can't afford to neglect any of the others." In the context of the today's increasingly polarized worldviews and talk of clashing civilizations, this turns out to be a rather contemporary and progressive conversation. - Robert Avila

Title: 968. The Waves of the Danube
description: Mihai leads members of the local resistance movement in an attack on a barge carrying weapons and ammunition for the Nazis in this World War II.

Title: 969. Baishey Shravana
description: The story set in the late 1930s in a remote village in Bengal, immediately before World War II. It portrays how poverty, famine, unemployment kills humanity.

Title: 970. Hibari no mori no ishimatsu
description: A traveler in Japan comes across three people pursuing a fleeing man; they almost capture and kill him with their swords. Helping the man escape his would-be killers, the traveler finds out that the man he aided murdered the father of one of his pursuers, and the three were seeking revenge and justice. Regretting his intervention the traveler begins his search for the fleeing man. He soon arrives at the ocean where a blind man, who is a thief, was beaten and needs help. The blind thief offers the traveler information on the escaping man.

Title: 973. Amor bajo cero
description: Following the steps of a beautiful skier, Ramon arrives to the Catalan Pyrenées pretending to be a professional.

Title: 975. Rip van Wyk

description: The story of a poor singer.

description: This film tells the story of Che Mamat, an individual who is always unlucky. All the work he does is always wrong and does not bring results. This causes him to always waste time telling stories to children. At the persuasion of his lover Fatimah, Che Mamat has participated in a short story writing contest. His victory opened a new chapter in his life when he got an offer to become a journalist in a newspaper.

description: About the struggle of the National Liberation Army of Korea against South Korean mercenaries, about the military operations of the People's Army scouts behind enemy lines.
